jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Ben jij de accountmanager die nieuwe kansen om zet naar langdurige relaties? Lees dan snel verder.

G-Nius zoekt een enthousiaste accountmanager:

Als Account Manager ben je commercieel gedreven, ondernemend, energiek, verkoop- en resultaatgericht. Daarbij beschik je over een flinke dosis doorzettingsvermogen. Je bent een verbinder, je genereert ideeën en zoekt naar creatieve mogelijkheden om nieuwe opdrachtgevers aan G-Nius te binden. Je werkt proactief aan een solide en langdurige samenwerking met zowel opdrachtgevers als met professionals.

Daarnaast ben je continu op zoek naar het maken van de perfecte match tussen professionals en opdrachtgevers. Je maakt hiervoor gebruik van jouw eigen netwerk als het zakelijk netwerk van G-Nius.

Wat ga je doen?

Bij G-Nius ben je als Sales Consultant actief in een 360 graden rol. Je draagt de zorg en verantwoordelijkheid voor het beheer van jouw relatiebestand. Dit bestand bestaat voornamelijk uit opdrachtgevers binnen de ICT-, Logistiek- en Managementomgeving.

Hiernaast ben je de verbinding tussen onze professionals en opdrachtgevers waarbij kwaliteit en open communicatie hoog in het vaandel staat. Dit doe je door in gesprek te gaan en de wensen en behoeften van beide partijen in kaart te brengen. Alleen zo kan je als Account Manager maatwerk bieden.

Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden bestaan uit:

Verkoopbeheer, accountbeheer en relatiebeheer.
Resourcemanagement.
Acquisitie new business.
Analyseren van personele behoefte, processen en wensen van de klant en deze vertalen in praktische oplossingen.
Commerciële activiteiten, zoals het voeren van verkoopgesprekken, het uitbrengen van offertes, het onderhandelen over en afsluiten van contracten.
Werving van professionals.
Voeren van sollicitatiegesprekken.
Interim- en Recruitment.
Contactpunt voor klant en professional.


Werken als Account Manager IT Detachering bij G-Nius

G-Nius is een onderneming waar een informele maar professionele sfeer heerst. We vinden openheid en betrokkenheid belangrijk.

We bieden je een zelfstandig functie binnen een jong en enthousiast team waar eigen initiatieven vanzelfsprekend zijn. Wanneer je er even niet uitkomt staan je collega's voor je klaar om ondersteuning te bieden.

Wij vinden het belangrijk dat ons team een hecht team is. Daarom lunchen wij altijd samen. Na de lunch lopen we een rondje door de binnenstad van s-Hertogenbosch om de middag weer vol goede energie te beginnen. Daarnaast organiseren wij leuke evenementen om elkaar, ook buiten kantoor, beter te leren kennen. Wil je meer weten over werken bij G-Nius? Kijk dan op www.werkenbijg-nius.nl.

jobs.title: Order picker
jobs.description:
Als orderpicker werk je in een magazijn in Bleiswijk. Je belangrijkste werkzaamheden zijn het verzamelen, inpakken en scannen van bestellingen en het correct voorbereiden van orders voor verdere verwerking.

Je werkt nauwkeurig, kunt instructies goed opvolgen en vindt het prettig om in teamverband te werken in een magazijnomgeving.

Ervaring in een magazijn of als orderpicker is een pré. Eerdere werkervaring is niet vereist voor deze vacature.

Op zoek naar een baan in de logistiek? Kom werken als orderpicker in Bleiswijk!

Als orderpicker werk je in een magazijn waar je bestellingen verzamelt, inpakt en scant. Samen met je collegas zorg je ervoor dat alle orders correct worden verwerkt en klaargemaakt.

Wat bieden wij?
14,99 bruto per uur
Wekelijkse uitbetaling van je salaris
Gratis vervoer van en naar het werk
Een rijbewijs is niet verplicht
Mogelijkheid om extra te verdienen als chauffeur

Heb je een geldig rijbewijs B? Dan kun je mogelijk collegas van en naar het werk vervoeren met een bedrijfsauto van Meta Carrière en hiervoor een extra vergoeding ontvangen.

Internationale kandidaten zijn welkom!
Je hoeft geen Nederlands te spreken. Voor deze functie accepteren wij kandidaten die Engels, Pools, Bulgaars, Spaans, Russisch of Oekraïens spreken.

Wat vragen wij?
Je werkt nauwkeurig en kunt instructies goed opvolgen
Je kunt goed samenwerken
Je bent bereid om in een magazijnomgeving te werken
Je bent al gerechtigd om in Nederland te werken

Meta Carrière helpt internationale werkzoekenden bij het vinden van werk in Nederland. Wij begeleiden onze medewerkers tijdens hun dienstverband en zorgen waar nodig voor vervoer van en naar het werk.

Interesse? Solliciteer direct via het online sollicitatieformulier. Ons recruitmentteam neemt contact met je op!

jobs.title: Word Allround Financieel Medewerker bij BAUHAUS - veel (doorgroei)kansen!
jobs.description:
Je leert stap voor stap de volledige financiële administratie kennen. Heb je al ervaring of zoek je meer uitdaging? Dan krijg je juist de ruimte om meer verantwoordelijkheid en uitdagendere werkzaamheden op te pakken.

Wil jij jezelf breed ontwikkelen binnen Finance?

Bij BAUHAUS werk je in een gezellig Finance team met korte lijnen naar onze CFO. Je krijgt de kans om de volledige financiele administratie te leren kennen en jezelf te ontwikkelen tot een echte allrounder.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met grootboekadministratie, facturen, banktransacties, debiteuren en crediteuren, betalingsvoorstellen en periodieke afsluitingen. Heb je al ervaring? Dan krijg je volop ruimte om meer verantwoordelijkheid en uitdagendere werkzaamheden op te pakken.

Je hebt een financiele opleiding afgerond of ervaring binnen financiele administratie en bent 32 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar. Ook starters zijn van harte welkom.

In 2027 opent BAUHAUS een nieuwe vestiging in Amersfoort. Daarom breiden we ons Finance team op het Service Center uit.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Export Pricing & Operations Coordinator
jobs.employer: Babaji Shivram Shipping and Logistics B.V.
jobs.description:
We are looking for someone who is hands-on, commercially aware and comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial environment.

4to 6 years of experience in freight forwarding, logistics, shipping, transport or supply-chain operations.
Strong understanding of international freight and export/import processes.
Existing network of freight forwarders, carriers, transporters, customs brokers or logistics service providers.
Strong coordination and communication skills.
Good understanding of logistics documentation and shipment processes.
Strong Excel / Microsoft Office skills.
Excellent written and verbal Dutch & English.
Experience in the Rotterdam / Netherlands logistics market.
Knowledge of European customs procedures.

About the Opportunity:
We are building our European operations from the ground up with Rotterdam as our base in the Netherlands. We are looking for an ambitious and hands-on Export Pricing & Operations Coordinator to join us at this exciting stage.

You will be one of the first people on the ground.

You will work closely and directly with the management team to help establish our logistics operations in the Netherlands, from identifying and onboarding vendors, building relationships with freight partners to developing pricing, coordinating shipments, establishing processes and supporting customer requirements.

About The Company:
We are an established global logistics and supply-chain organisation with extensive experience across freight forwarding, customs clearance, transportation, warehousing and international supply-chain solutions. We have offices across the globe - US, China, Dubai, Oman, Saudi, Singapore, Canada and 22 offices within India.

As part of our international expansion, we are now establishing our European presence from Rotterdam.

Our ambition is to develop the Netherlands into an important operational and commercial hub for our European activities and build a strong, reliable network across Europe.

jobs.title: QHSE Manager wanted - Quality first mentality - Rotterdam
jobs.description:
Quality First Mentality!

Ben jij de kwaliteitsprofessional die het verschil maakt?

Jij bent een kwaliteitsbewuste professional die hoge standaarden weet te combineren met een pragmatische en oplossingsgerichte aanpak. Met jouw kritische blik zie je verbeterkansen waar anderen ze missen, terwijl je tegelijkertijd mensen weet mee te nemen in veranderingen en kwaliteitsdoelstellingen.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

- ISO 9001 certified

Ready to make an impact in a company where Quality First truly matters?

jobs.title: Workforce Coordinator
jobs.description:
Jij bent het vaste aanspreekpunt voor onze uitzendkrachten, van eerste contact tot dagelijkse begeleiding. Je werkt nauw samen met account management en draagt verantwoordelijkheid voor werving, onboarding en de doorlopende coaching van een vaste groep medewerkers.

Je werft technische vakmensen via ons Europese netwerk van recruitment partner. Na plaatsing begeleid je de volledige onboarding: accommodatie, sleuteloverdracht, contractverwerking en informatieoverdracht aan de medewerker.
Daarna volgt structurele begeleiding. Je checkt regelmatig in; op kantoor, thuis bij de medewerker of op de werkplek. Ziekmeldingen en verlofaanvragen lopen via jou. Je beheert daarnaast ons WhatsApp-kanaal: de dagelijkse communicatielijn met onze medewerkers.

GR8 Move is een uitzendbureau gespecialiseerd in technisch personeel. Wij leveren monteurs aan de industrie, maritiem en (nieuw)bouw. Onze uitzendkrachten komen uit heel Europa, zijn snel inzetbaar en vakbekwaam. We regelen meer dan alleen de plaatsing: van selectie en begeleiding tot kwalitatieve huisvesting. Zo zorgen wij dat onze opdrachtgevers gewoon kunnen doorwerken.

jobs.title: Cleaning Employee
jobs.description:
Enjoy a job on the coast of Zeeland. You enjoy making the holiday homes look clean and tidy again. As part of the MVH cleaning team you work in Cadzand, at a beautiful holiday park. The accommodations are gorgeous holiday homes. You are available every Monday and/or Friday. With our bus you can be picked up and drive to Cadzand-Bad to deliver the houses spick and span from 10.00 to 16.00 o'clock.

You go to the location with your team to work in Cadzand with one of our buses or cars. We have pick-up points in Hulst, Axel, Koewacht and Terneuzen. You clean the houses quickly and good, so that the new guests can enjoy their well-deserved vacation. The work includes vacuuming, cleaning wet areas, dusting, removing beds and possibly cleaning a window if it is too dirty.

Do you have an eye for cleanliness, are you meticulous and do you see what others do not see? Register now and join our fun and hard working pool of employees and get to work with your colleagues in Cadzand.

You work on Mondays and/or Fridays from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM in Cadzand. If you are asked to continue working a little longer or an extra day, that is of course no problem for you.

The CAO recreation does not reimburse travel time and travel costs. However, MVH offers you 2 hour extra pay, when you drive a bus or car with collegues!

The company

Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Direct Acquisition team at iwoca is responsible for acquiring customers profitably across paid and organic channels. Paid Social is one of our highest-growth channels; we've validated the opportunity, proven incrementality, and scaled from test budgets to six-figure monthly spend across Meta and TikTok. Now we need to build on those foundations and scale toward a 3x growth ambition across a multi-product offering that includes both flexi-loans and credit cards.

You'll join a team that:

  • Takes measurement seriously: We run conversion lift studies, work closely with data science on attribution, and make budget decisions based on predicted and incremental ROI, not vanity metrics.

  • Cares deeply about creative: We believe the ad is the targeting, and we're building a creative engine that spans creator partnerships, UGC, and AI-assisted production.

  • Is genuinely AI-native: We use AI tools daily for analysis, creative development, and workflow automation, and we expect you to do the same.

The role

Paid Social at iwoca is working; we've proven the channel's incremental value, scaled to six-figure monthly spend, and built the measurement infrastructure to back it up. But there's a lot more to go after with a credit card to bring to market, a creative engine to build, and a lot of room still to scale. The remit is broad - you'll scale the channel, bring our credit card to market and grow it aggressively alongside our core lending product. You'll invest heavily in creative - particularly video and influencer marketing - building ads that actually cut through in a category where most ads look the same.

Key responsibilities include:

Strategy & Campaign Architecture

  • Own Paid Social as a channel: set the vision, define the road map, allocate budget, and report on performance to leadership.

  • Bring our credit card product to market through paid social: build the campaign strategy, creative approach, and measurement framework for a major product launch.

  • Architect full-funnel structures across Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn - awareness, prospecting, lead capture, re-targeting, and conversion - with clear success metrics, audience hand-offs, and frequency management at each stage.

  • Manage multi-product overlap: flexi-loans, credit cards, and other products share audiences but serve different customer needs.

  • Expand audience reach through content-led lead capture campaigns targeting out-of-market prospects to fuel top-of-funnel growth.

  • Scale into new platforms where there's genuine opportunity; we’ve validated a significant opportunity on TikTok, but other platforms such as Linkedin and Youtube Shorts remain largely untapped.

Creative Strategy & Production

  • Develop creative that actually stands out: paid social in financial services is full of generic stock imagery and safe messaging. We want you to push beyond that, finding the concepts, formats, and creators that people actually notice.

  • Make a significant investment in video and influencer marketing: build relationships with creators who can speak authentically about business finance, and develop a pipeline that delivers volume without it becoming generic.

  • Build a testing framework that connects creative concepts to commercial outcomes

  • Partner with the Brand team to make sure performance and brand creative reinforce each other rather than pulling in different directions.

Measurement & Incrementality

  • Design, run, and turn conversion lift studies and geo-lift tests into investment cases that prove incremental value and justify budget expansion.

  • Partner with Data Science and the Acquitech team on attribution methodology, event architecture, and multi-step conversion tracking.

  • Extend testing beyond ad platforms to landing page experiments and signup flow improvements to reduce drop-off between click and conversion.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage and develop a Performance Marketing Executive, coaching them on strategic thinking and commercial analysis while delegating clear operational ownership.

  • Partner with Data Science, Engineering, Compliance, and Brand teams, while getting genuine strategic value from Meta and TikTok platform reps.

The requirements

  • Mechanically curious: You understand why platforms work the way they do, stay updated on algorithmic changes, and have an industry network for shared learning.

  • High-initiative: You define experiments, draft business cases, and drive projects forward without waiting for explicit briefs.

  • Analytically self-sufficient: You pull your own data, build your own performance views, and think in terms of CLTV, ROI, and marginal returns.

  • AI-native: You already use AI tools meaningfully in your work - whether for creative analysis, reporting, workflow automation, or something we haven't thought of.

  • Commercially minded: You care about profitable customer acquisition and lifetime value.

What You Bring:

  • Proven track record of scaling paid social budgets based on measured commercial performance.

  • Deep campaign architecture expertise on Meta (bidding strategies, audience signals, and creative interaction).

  • Experience with multi-product, multi-market and value-based bidding models.

  • Strategic creative capability connecting concepts to commercial hypotheses.

Nice to Have:

  • B2B paid social experience (or strong analytical background in B2C).

  • Experience managing or coaching junior team members.

  • Fluency in measurement and incrementality (conversion lift studies, holdout methodologies, and incremental value).

  • Hands-on experience with TikTok advertising at scale.

  • Fintech or financial services background.

The compensation

£70,000 - £90,000 (bench marked regularly with quarterly performance reviews).

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the iwocaPay Risk Squad

You'll own credit models that decide who iwocaPay can safely fund and on what terms. The team is small, the product is growing, and you'll shape how risk modelling is built – not just maintain what exists.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The function

iwoca's Data Scientists specialise in supervised machine learning, statistical inference and exploratory data analysis, focusing on tabular and time series data. Our work emphasises quantitative predictions through the analysis of conditional probabilities and expectations, using medium-sized datasets.

The team

iwocaPay is iwoca's B2B Buy Now Pay Later product. The Risk Squad owns the automated credit decisioning and fraud prevention models that influence every lending decision the product makes. The squad also handles counterparty risk, portfolio-level strategy, and ongoing monitoring of losses, chargebacks, and segment performance.

The role

You'll co-own the full credit modelling stack with one other data scientist. You’ll collaborate on model design, review each other's work, and choose what to prioritise. Your models directly control which small businesses get access to funding, on what terms, and how far the product can grow.

What you'll get out of it:

Complex problems to solve

Work on interesting, open modelling problems rather than maintenance. Improving how the model performs across segments, test more advanced approaches, and build models from scratch for new products.

Real influence

You own the models end to end, and your decisions carry commercial weight.

Room to develop

A small team on a growing product means broad remit, fast growth, and a say in how the team's pipelines, monitoring, and processes get built.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Gap Assurance: Evaluate the mapping of financial crime typologies against active transaction monitoring coverage to independently identify and escalate potential tracking gaps to senior management.

2. Independent Compliance Challenge & Assurance Framework

  • Segmentation & Calibration Challenge: Provide independent, 2LoD challenge to data-driven customer segmentation methodologies executed by the First Line (1LoD), verifying alignment with merchant risk profiles.

  • Metrics & KRI Oversight: Assist in the production of 2LoD Management Information (MI) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) to track the effectiveness of the compliance oversight posture for the Head of TM and Global MLRO.

3. Data Integrity & Alert Lifecycle Assurance

  • Data Lineage Assurance: Review documentation regarding data lineage, integrity, and completeness for feeds ingested into the monitoring architecture to ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

  • Lifecycle Evaluation: Evaluate the end-to-end alert workflow governance, risk scoring frameworks, and prioritization mechanics to ensure high-risk alerts adhere to compliant escalation paths.

  • Feedback Loops: Analyze high-level alert outcomes and disposition trends to provide compliance feedback loops to technical teams, supporting iterative improvements in the quality of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs).

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: Typically 5+ years of experience within Financial Crime Compliance, with a specific focus on the independent oversight, assurance, or evaluation of Transaction Monitoring frameworks within a regulated PSP, FinTech, or financial institution.

About the team

Checkout.com is building the infrastructure that will allow merchants to be discovered, transacted with and paid through AI agents.

Agentic commerce is moving quickly from concept to production. AI platforms, card schemes and merchants are developing different protocols for discovery, cart, payment, identity and consent. No standard has won, and merchants should not have to rebuild their commerce stack for every new platform.

We are looking for a Product Manager to help make Checkout.com the layer that connects this ecosystem. This is a 0→1 role in a new product area with live merchant and platform activity, a growing inventory API, ACP and UCP work, and a roadmap that will extend across discovery, cart and payment.

  • Build the next stage of the product: live catalogue and inventory feeds that make merchants discoverable across AI surfaces, followed by the right cart and orchestration capabilities.

  • Extend Checkout.com’s payment strengths into agentic flows: delegated credentials, authentication, agent identification, consent, risk decisioning, approval performance and dispute evidence.

About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be doing

As our Head of Brand, you'll own the creative and brand strategy end-to-end, bridging the gap between high-level storytelling and measurable business impact, ensuring our mission resonates across every touchpoint.

  • Leadership & Team Rituals - Building and mentoring the team behind these pillars, establishing clear creative rituals (design reviews, sprints, feedback loops) and tools to ensure efficient, high-quality output.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration - Partnering closely with Growth and Product teams to align brand initiatives with acquisition goals, retention targets, and product launches.

  • Performance-Driven Branding - Defining and tracking KPIs for brand awareness and consideration, ensuring that even the most "creative" projects are data-informed and contribute to Satispay's overarching OKRs.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

Who we're looking for

You'll take on one of the hardest challenges at our scale: defining Satispay's identity globally while ensuring our brand initiatives directly align with acquisition and retention goals — and building the creative team and rituals that stay ahead of it as we grow. We're not looking for a caretaker of an existing setup. We're looking for someone who has built or transformed a function, made hard calls under pressure, and can say "here's the decision, here's why, here's what happened."

  • Lead cross-functional projects with analysts, engineers, and compliance teams to build and maintain high-quality data pipelines and sources

  • Support ad-hoc data requests for audits, exams, risk assessments, and day-to-day business needs

  • Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high fidelity data for reporting and decision-making

  • Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of data workflow orchestration

jobs.title: Senior Finance & FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
Mission

Integral was founded in October 2024 and is already one of the fastest-growing startups in Germany. We're building the leading AI-native platform for accounting, payroll, and tax for European SMEs, and we're looking for the sharpest people to help us get there.

As our first dedicated Senior Finance & FP&A Manager, you will build the financial planning & analysis function from the ground up and report directly to the CFO. You will own the group's forecasting and planning engine, sharpen ARR and liquidity steering, and be a core partner on fundraising, board reporting and go-to-market economics. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build.

 

Your Tasks

  • Planning & forecasting: Own and continuously improve the integrated business plan (P&L, cash flow, balance sheet), including consolidation logic.

  • Budgeting: Run the annual budget and rolling re-forecast; translate strategy into a defensible operating plan and use-of-funds.

  • Performance steering with KPIs & BI: Define and report the KPIs that matter and build them into our BI dashboard. Flag risks and levers early.

  • IR & fundraising: Support board and investor reporting and potential future funding rounds with models and investor-grade materials.

  • GTM & cohorts: Build and own cohort analytics tied to go-to-market (e.g. retention, payback period, LTV/CAC and margin by acquisition channel). Turn these into concrete recommendations on spend and channel mix.

  • Business partnering: Partner with Commercial and Service Operations leaders on unit economics, pricing, funnel efficiency and investment decisions.

  • Scalable processes & automation: Design processes that scale with rapid growth by using AI and agentic tooling to make planning faster, cleaner and repeatable.

  • Operational Finance: Own accounts payable and receivable, and drive timely, accurate month-end and year-end closes together with our tax advisory team.

 

Your Profile

  • Experience: 5+ years in FP&A, accounting/controlling, investment banking or a comparable analytical finance role, ideally with high-growth / VC-backed / scale-up exposure.

  • Modelling: Expert financial modelling; you build clean, three-statement models and defend the assumptions.

  • Commercial: Fluent in unit economics, recurring-revenue and cash metrics; comfortable turning messy data into decisions.

  • Tools: Advanced Excel/Sheets; experience with BI/planning, DATEV and AI tooling a strong plus.

  • Language: You operate in English and German; investor and board materials are produced in English.

  • Mindset: Hands-on, structured, comfortable with ambiguity and first-of-role ownership in a scaling environment.

  • Agentic mindset: You default to AI and agentic tools to automate the repetitive and build leverage - you think in reusable processes and systems, not one-off spreadsheets, so finance scales faster than headcount.

  • Qualification: Degree in finance, business or a quantitative field; CFA, MBA or qualified-accountant background welcome.

What we're not looking for

  • People who wait to be told what to do.

  • "That's not my job" energy at the handoff between teams.

  • Anyone who treats compliance and documentation as red tape to skip rather than the thing that protects the client.

 

Process

We move fast. For the right candidate the whole process takes less than two weeks.

  1. Virtual call ​with our Talent Team

  2. Virtual Case Study based on a real challenge we're facing that you'd solve

  3. Invitation to our office to meet the team, product, and run through your case study

  4. Reference call

 

Our Offer

  • Direct line to the CFO and Co-Founder/CEO exposure

  • Competitive compensation package

  • 28 vacation days per year, plus half-days on December 24 and 31

  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Sachbezüge/Coupons to over 200 partners or a Deutschland Ticket

  • Company pension scheme (bAV)

  • Modern equipment setup for your needs to succeed

  • Modern office in the heart of Berlin Prenzlauer Berg

  • Weekly team lunches on us, office BBQs, and a dinner budget for late nights after 8 p.m.

  • A team of 50+ (and growing) ambitious, diverse experts, 20%+ ex-founders, learning and building together

  • A category-defining growth story in a large, underserved market, with an AI-enabled operating model.

We value diversity and hire people based on their abilities and capabilities to succeed in this role. We welcome people of every background, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status, political belief or marital status.

jobs.title: Directeur commercial / Directrice commerciale export (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Location: Gennevilliers, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d'activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l'environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d'euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l'innovation tels que l'IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays.

Nos engagements, vos avantages***Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée***Un package de rémunération attractif***Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes***Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l'équilibre des collaborateurs***Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Le Campus de Gennevilliers est le cœur des activités de conception, de développement et de soutien des grands systèmes de défense : radiocommunications, réseaux et systèmes d'infrastructure résilients, communications par satellite, combat collaboratif et cybersécurité. Situé au nord de Paris, il est rapidement accessible en transports en commun.

En tant que Responsable Commercial Export, vous intégrerez l'équipe de Soutien et des Services des produits de Thales SIX (principalement les produits de radios communications).

A ce titre, vos missions principales seront les suivantes :

1.Développer, identifier de nouvelles opportunités auprès de portefeuille de clients pour des offres de services, de maintien en condition opérationnelles, de rénovation de systèmes existants, de rechanges et de réparations, voire de Performance Based Contract (PCB).

2. Soutenir la construction des offres en collaboration avec les différentes fonctions internes (Marketing, projets, finance, juridique, achat, qualité, export control, etc.) pour nos clients industriels et étatiques dans plus de 50 pays.

3. Piloter l'ensemble du processus commercial : de la prévision et qualification des opportunités, la constitution des offres, à la négociation et signature des contrats, puis l'initialisation et le suivi des obligations réglementaires.

4. Interagir quotidiennement avec les différents Key Account Managers des entités locales de Thales (Defense Services Centers, Partenaires) déployés sur les pays export et avec les différents clients.

Votre profil

Titulaire d'un diplôme type Bac+5 (école de commerce ou équivalent), vous justifiez d'une expérience significative de plus de 5 ans à l'international dans le domaine du commerce export ou sur un poste en Business Développement dans le domaine des services et du support.

Vous êtes proactif, curieux et autonome dans la réalisation de vos tâches.

Vous avez une appétence pour les projets techniques.

Vous maitrisez les outils bureautiques.

Vous avez un bon relationnel et un esprit collaboratif.

Vous maitrisez l'anglais couramment.

Vous vous reconnaissez ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

Le mot du manager

Nous vous proposons de rejoindre une équipe pluridisciplinaire, pour travailler dans un secteur en pleine croissance internationale.

At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

jobs.title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

At Bliq, we are building and launching driverless vehicles for everyday life and business operations across Europe.

We are looking for a Account Executive to help bring them to customers.

You will acquire business and individual customers across European markets and own the commercial process end-to-end: identify and engage prospects, run discovery, demonstrate the product in person, design the right commercial and operating model for each customer, build proposals, negotiate, and close.

Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold.

You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market.

Responsibilities

  • Own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed contract

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound and proactive prospecting across European markets

  • Run sharp discovery conversations that uncover customer operations, economics, pain points, and decision criteria

  • Conduct live Bliq vehicle demos and turn the experience into a compelling commercial conversation

  • Develop deployment concepts together with prospects, including use case, fleet size, operating model, responsibilities, economics, and rollout plan

  • Create proposals, commercial models, LOIs, and contracts together with the relevant internal teams

  • Navigate complex buying processes involving operators, management teams, fleet owners, partners, and other stakeholders

  • Build relationships with customers across mobility, taxi, car sharing, rental, real estate, professional services, and other relevant sectors

  • Own defined markets and be accountable for commercial progress within them

  • Keep CRM data, pipeline, next steps, and forecasts accurate

  • Test new segments, messages, channels, and commercial models and turn what works into repeatable processes

  • Work closely with the Customer Deployment team to make sure signed customers can actually be deployed successfully

  • Represent Bliq at customer meetings, industry events, demos, and market visits across Europe

  • Support B2C sales initiatives when they become part of the GTM strategy

  • Bring customer feedback directly into Bliq’s product, operations, and commercial decisions



Your profile

Apply if this describes you:

  • You have at least 2 years of Account Executive or comparable full-cycle sales experience

  • You are a hunter and enjoy creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound demand

  • You learn quickly and can become credible on a complex technical product without hiding behind technical jargon

  • You are excellent face-to-face and comfortable walking into an important customer meeting, running the room, and demonstrating a physical product

  • You are customer-first and care about finding solutions that make customers satisfied

  • You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to turn customer needs into a viable deal

  • You write clearly and can produce concise, convincing emails, proposals, and commercial documents

  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented; pipeline hygiene, follow-ups, and commitments do not get lost

  • You have CRM experience and understand disciplined sales processes

  • Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar is a plus

  • You know how to use AI to research, prepare, analyze, and move faster while keeping the thinking and customer judgment your own

  • You have a figure-it-out mindset and remain effective when there is no existing template for the problem

  • You are comfortable owning a market or commercial project and being measured by the outcome

  • You can work professionally in German and English; additional European languages are a plus

  • You are based in Berlin

  • You are willing to travel regularly across Europe

  • Experience selling hardware, mobility, automotive, physical technology, or other operationally complex products is a strong plus

This role will probably not suit you if you want an established sales process, a narrowly defined territory, a predictable product demo, or a manager telling you exactly what to do next.

It will suit you if you want to help create a category, sell something people can experience in the real world, and build the commercial machine while running it.


Why us?

  • Sell a product people are excited about

  • Build Bliq’s sales playbook together with the Commercial Lead

  • Work directly with the founders and senior team

  • Own meaningful customer relationships and markets from an early stage

  • Work on complex deals combining technology, vehicles, operations, economics, and regulation

  • See deals move from your first message to vehicles operating on public roads with the customer

  • Fast decisions, direct feedback, and no bureaucracy

  • Strong compensation package with meaningful upside for performance

  • Significant room to grow as Bliq expands across European markets

Tips for a successful application

  1. Show us that you can sell. Generic applications tell us very little.

  2. Tell us what you have personally owned and what results you produced.

  3. If you have built pipeline, opened a new market, sold a difficult product, or closed an unusual deal, tell us how.

  4. Use AI as a tool. Make sure the thinking and personality in your application are yours.

jobs.title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
jobs.description:
Your mission

At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments.

This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that.

The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup.
The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. 
E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation.

You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved.

What you will work on

  • Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing

  • Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

  • Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments

  • Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA- and NGC-based workloads

  • Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs

  • Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets

  • Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation

  • Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation

  • Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics

  • Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments

  • Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting

  • Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC, secrets management, SSO, and tenant boundaries

  • Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows



Your profile

We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature.
You should bring:

  • Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software

  • Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference

  • Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking

  • Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows

  • Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA, and GPU scheduling

  • The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently

  • A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility

  • Very good English; German is a plus


We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience.


Nice to have

  • Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD

  • Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines

  • Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies

  • Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling

  • Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows

  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements



Why us?

Make an impact!
Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact!

Our teams inspire!
Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things!

Be authentic!
Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work!

Help others!
You can have up to 3 days of volunteer time off to help your favorite charity.

Develop yourself!
We offer training and mental health opportunities so that you can develop both mentally and professionally.

And there is even more!
Enjoy our free lunch, snacks and drinks, team events, 30 days of annual vacation + additional rest during Christmas season until New Year. If your child gets sick, we assure that a 100% of your usual earnings will be paid while you take care of your little one.

jobs.description:
Your mission

At Wandelbots, we combine modern software development with industrial robotics and automation. With NOVA, we are building a platform that makes the use of industrial robots easier, more flexible, and more software-driven. As an Automation Engineer, you will work right at this intersection: You will commission automation systems and robots, support our teams with your hands-on industrial expertise, and implement customer-specific solutions based on NOVA. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Platform
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the role: 

We are seeking talented distributed systems engineers who are passionate about building innovative solutions for application deployment. Your mission will be to enhance the capabilities of Replit Infrastructure, optimize performance across global regions, and drive efficiency while delivering an exceptional user experience. If you have a strong foundation in software development, a deep understanding of cloud technologies, and a track record of delivering high-quality code, we want to hear from you. 



In this role you will:

 - Expand Replit's cloud infrastructure offerings: Launch new cloud products to be used by Replit Agent to build complex apps. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement these features, empowering developers with a comprehensive suite of tools to build and deploy their applications efficiently.

 - Enhance reliability and scalability: Identify bottlenecks, optimize critical paths, and implement robust monitoring and alerting systems. Work closely with the SRE team to ensure high availability and minimal downtime. Enable our customers to seamlessly scale their applications to meet the demands of their growing user base.

 - Improve utilization of cloud infrastructure: Analyze our infrastructure costs and identify opportunities for optimization. Implement strategies to reduce cloud expenses without compromising performance or reliability. This could involve techniques such as resource provisioning, auto-scaling, cost-aware scheduling, and data lifecycle management. Your efforts will directly contribute to the financial efficiency of our cloud services.



Required skills and experience:

 - Distributed systems: Track record of working with platform-as-a-service, distributed storage, or information retrieval systems. Experience in designing scalable architectures and optimizing systems for latency or cost. 

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex challenges pragmatically and devise effective solutions. You think radically but ship incrementally.

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Able to work independently, set priorities, and drive projects forward. You take ownership and initiative.

 - Versatility and flexibility: Able to wear multiple hats and tackle a wide range of challenges. You are comfortable working across different layers of the stack and adapting to the needs of the project.

 - Continuous learning and adaptability: Passionate about staying up-to-date with industry trends and expanding your skill set. You embrace change and adapt quickly.



Nice to have:

 - Experience working on cloud infrastructure or platform products, particularly in the areas of application deployment, serverless computing, or container orchestration.

 - Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools, such as GCE, GKE,, Cloud Run, or Cloud Storage.

 - Contributions to open-source projects related to cloud technologies, deployment frameworks, or developer tools. We love OSS!



Tools + Tech Stack for this role

 - Golang, Rust



This role may not be a fit if

 - You are a generalist backend engineer who hasn’t built scalable distributed systems.

 - You cannot take part in the oncall rotation of min 6 people.

 - You do not enjoy diving into Linux internals. 



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Cloud and Data Platform Lead
jobs.description: Cloud and Data Platform Lead. Siinä on energiaa - Tule meille näyttämään kykysi ja rakentamaan puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää! Me Helenissä tarjoamme helpompaa ja mutkattomampaa arkea kaikkialla Suomessa. Lämmön, jäähdytyksen ja sähkön lisäksi tarjoamme ratkaisuja alueelliseen ja uusiutuvaan energiaan sekä sähköiseen liikenteeseen. Kehitämme fiksumpaa ja puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää, jonka avulla pidämme huolta, että asiakkaamme voivat tuottaa, käyttää ja säästää energiaa ympäristöä kunnioittaen. Vähennämme suunnitelmallisesti päästöjämme ja tavoitteemme on irtautua polttamiseen perustuvasta energiantuotannosta vuoteen 2040 mennessä. Etsimme nyt joukkoomme Pilvi- ja data-alustan omistajaa vastaamaan Helenin yhteisten pilvi- ja data-alustapalveluiden kokonaisuudesta ja niiden kehittämisestä. Työsuhde on vakituinen. Pilvi- ja data-alustan omistajana huolehdit siitä, että alustapalvelut muodostavat liiketoimintaa ja digitaalisten ratkaisujen kehittämistä tukevan, hallitun ja jatkuvasti kehittyvän kokonaisuuden. Tehtävä ei ole ensisijaisesti syvällinen tekninen asiantuntijarooli, vaan sinun tulee ymmärtää pilvi- ja dataratkaisujen toimintaympäristöä ja mahdollisuuksia. Pilvi- ja data-alustojen kehittämistä tehdään Helenissä virtuaalitiimin voimin. Roolissasi Vastaat Helenin pilvi- ja data-alustapalveluiden kokonaisuudesta, niiden elinkaaresta ja suunnitelmallisesta kehittämisestä.Määrität yhdessä liiketoiminnan, arkkitehtuurin ja teknisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa alustapalveluiden tavoitetilaa.Vastaat alustapalveluiden laadusta, jatkuvuudesta, kustannustehokkuudesta, tietoturvasta ja tarkoituksenmukaisesta elinkaarenhallinnasta.Rakennat selkeitä palvelumalleja ja huolehdit siitä, että alustojen tarjoamat kyvykkyydet ovat niitä hyödyntäville tiimeille helposti ymmärrettäviä ja käytettäviä.Ohjaat palveluiden tuottamiseen ja kehittämiseen osallistuvia kumppaneita ja varmistat, että tekeminen etenee yhteisten tavoitteiden mukaisesti.Varmistat aktiivisen yhteistyön liiketoiminnan, IT:n, data- ja analytiikkatoimintojen, arkkitehtuurin, kyberturvan sekä muiden keskeisten sidosryhmien välillä.Toivomme sinulta Vähintään noin viiden vuoden kokemusta laajojen IT-palveluiden, alustojen tai digitaalisten kyvykkyyksien omistamisesta ja kehittämisestä.Hyvää kokonaisymmärrystä pilvi- ja data-alustoista liiketoiminnan ja digitaalisten palveluiden mahdollistajana sekä liiketoiminnan tarpeiden ja teknologian yhdistämisestä.Kykyä tarkastella palveluita myös kustannusten, riskien, jatkuvuuden ja käyttäjäkokemuksen näkökulmista.Kokemusta toimittaja- ja kumppanijohtamisesta sekä kykyä ohjata useiden toimijoiden muodostamaa kokonaisuutta.Hyviä yhteistyö-, viestintä- ja vaikuttamistaitoja sekä kykyä rakentaa yhteistä ymmärrystä erilaisten sidosryhmien välillä. Emme etsi tehtävään yksittäisen pilviteknologian syväosaajaa, vaan suunnannäyttäjää, joka pystyy johtamaan alustapalveluita kokonaisuutena ja tekemään niiden kehittämisestä liiketoimintalähtöistä. Tarjoamme sinulle Pilvi- ja data-alustat ovat keskeisiä mahdollistajia Helenin digitaalisten palveluiden, datan hyödyntämisen, analytiikan ja uusien AI-ratkaisujen kehittämisessä. Tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, millaisia yhteisiä kyvykkyyksiä Helen tarjoaa kehittäjille ja liiketoiminnoille sekä miten niitä kehitetään tulevaisuudessa. Saat vastuullesi kokonaisuuden, jossa onnistuminen ei tarkoita vain teknisesti toimivaa alustaa. Tavoitteena on rakentaa palveluita, jotka ovat käyttäjilleen selkeitä, helposti hyödynnettäviä, kustannustehokkaita ja turvallisia ja jotka kehittyvät Helenin liiketoiminnan mukana. Pääset nauttimaan myös erilaisista henkilöstöeduistamme, kuten henkilöstösähköstä, hyväntekeväisyystyöpäivästä, etätyömahdollisuudesta ulkomailla ja hyvinvointiedusta. Toimistomme sijaitsee Ruoholahden We Landissa, ja työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla. Tehtävän palkka määritellään tehtävän vaativuuden sekä osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Voit kysyä meillä työskentelystä tai tehtävästä tarkemmin tulevalta esihenkilöltäsi (Jarmo Ojamo / etunimi.sukunimi@helen.fi) sähköpostitse. Kiinnostuitko? Mahtavaa! Voit hakea rekryjärjestelmämme kautta viimeistään 11.10.2026. Huomioithan, että käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

Vähennämme suunnitelmallisesti päästöjämme ja tavoitteemme on irtautua polttamiseen perustuvasta energiantuotannosta vuoteen 2040 mennessä. Etsimme nyt Data Engineeriä kehittämään joustavan kaukolämmön dataratkaisuja ja data-arkkitehtuuria osana Helenin Lämmön kysyntäjoustoratkaisut -tiimiä. Tehtävä on määräaikainen vanhempainvapaan sijaisuus, ja työsuhteen kesto on noin 8 kuukautta. Työsuhteen toivottu aloitusajankohta on viimeistään loka-marraskuussa 2026. Lämmön kysyntäjoustoratkaisut -tiimimme vastaa Optimilämpö-tuotteen jatkuvasta digitaalisesta kehityksestä ja varmistaa kaukolämpöverkon joustokyvyn osana Helenin kokonaisoptimointia. Tiimi ylläpitää tuotteen digiratkaisuja sekä kehittää uusia digitaalisia kyvykkyyksiä, lämmönjakokeskusten etähallintaan tarvittavia yhteysratkaisuja ja omaa jouston ohjausalgoritmia. Roolissasi Vastaat joustavan kaukolämmön data-arkkitehtuurin ja -infrastruktuurin kehittämisestä.Rakennat Databricks data-alustalle datatuotteita ja vastaat datan jalostamisesta dokumentoiduiksi tietoaineistoiksi.Vastaat dataintegraatioiden rakentamisesta, ylläpidosta ja kehittämisestä Helenin yhteisten data-alustakäytäntöjen mukaisesti.Kehität datan laadun ja dataputkien luotettavuuden monitorointia sekä siihen tarvittavia työkaluja.Odotamme sinulta Relevanttia työkokemusta moderneista data-alustoista, ensisijaisesti Databricksistä.Vahvaa SQL-osaamista sekä kokemusta Pythonin ja Sparkin käytöstä.Kokemusta datan mallinnuksesta, transformoinnista ja suurten datamäärien käsittelystä.Hyvää ymmärrystä ohjelmistokehityksen käytännöistä, kuten versionhallinnasta (Git), CI/CD:stä, testiautomaatiosta ja Infrastructure as Code (IaC) -periaatteista.Ymmärrystä skaalautuvien data- ja IoT-ratkaisujen rakentamisesta.Hyviä yhteistyö- sekä vuorovaikutustaitoja, avoimuutta ja rohkeutta. Tärkeää on halu oppia uutta, kaikkea ei tarvi osata ennalta.Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Arvostamme kykyä hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia, tehdä perusteltuja teknisiä ratkaisuja ja kehittää dataratkaisuja yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Tukea työssäsi saat niin ratkaisutiimiltäsi kuin koko Helenin datayhteisöltä. Tarjoamme sinulle Tässä tehtävässä pääset rakentamaan datakyvykkyyksiä, joilla on suora yhteys Helenin lämpöverkon joustavuuden kehittämiseen ja puhtaamman energiajärjestelmän rakentamiseen. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit enables people to build software with AI. The systems underneath that experience must support safe production changes, measurable reliability, and predictable performance as usage grows.

This Engineering Manager will lead SRE across observability, incident management, load testing, performance engineering, cloud cost and capacity, and rollout infrastructure. You'll lead and grow an existing team that builds and operates production platforms and works hands-on across application and infrastructure boundaries.

This is a software-building leadership role, not simply an incident-management function. You'll help teams ship safely, understand production behavior, and remove performance bottlenecks through concrete engineering improvements. You should be comfortable going deep on a rollout failure or performance investigation while developing technical leaders and sustainable ownership across a distributed team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Observability. Build and operate metrics, logs, traces, and alerting capabilities. Help teams establish meaningful SLOs and use production telemetry to diagnose problems and verify improvements.

 - Incident Management. Own incident tooling and practices, coordinate cross-team response, and turn incident reviews into engineering improvements that reduce recovery time and repeat failures.

 - Load Testing. Build and maintain load/failure testing capabilities. Validate critical paths under expected demand, quantify headroom, and test recovery and production readiness with service owners.

 - Performance Engineering. Lead deep engagements with internal teams on SLOs and end-to-end performance. Use profiling, telemetry, and load tests to identify bottlenecks and deliver improvements with service owners—not just recommendations.

 - Stay technically engaged. Review designs and production changes, debug difficult failure modes, and use AI coding tools—including Replit—to prototype and automate. Apply rigorous review and verification to AI-generated changes.

 - Build and grow a high-ownership engineering team. Coach engineers, develop technical leaders, manage performance, and hire against agreed needs. Make distributed collaboration, mentoring, and backup coverage deliberate rather than relying on a few permanent escalation points.

 - Measure outcomes and close the loop. Track rollout safety, recovery time, repeat incidents, critical-path latency/throughput, test coverage, and improvements arising from cost/capacity analysis. Agree success measures and continuing ownership with partner teams.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Demonstrated engineering management. You have led and developed engineers, made prioritization and performance decisions, hired thoughtfully, and delivered through a team—not only acted as its strongest individual contributor.

 - Software-oriented production systems depth. You have built and operated distributed systems or reliability platforms and can reason across deployment behavior, Kubernetes, telemetry, service dependencies, and recovery mechanisms.

 - Safe-change and performance judgment. You have led consequential migrations or incidents and used measurement to diagnose reliability or performance problems. You can distinguish symptoms from causes and validate fixes under realistic conditions.

 - Platform-product and cross-team judgment. You can build capabilities other teams adopt, lead hands-on engagements without absorbing every service's operations, and make clear tradeoffs among reliability, performance, engineering effort, and cost.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with GitOps or progressive-delivery platforms such as Harness, ArgoCD, or Kargo.

 - Experience with observability, profiling, load-testing, and failure-testing systems, including OpenTelemetry or comparable tooling.

 - Experience with cloud cost attribution, capacity planning, and provider coordination, particularly on GCP.

 - Experience growing distributed teams and using AI tools to increase engineering output while preserving production safeguards.

jobs.title: Senior Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

Integrated Marketing France orchestrates major marketing moments, brand initiatives and local activations, working closely with central functional teams.

The Senior Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager translates central marketing direction, France business priorities, and consumer and performance insights into an integrated 360° marketing plan tailored to the French market. They bring local and central expertise together, make prioritisation recommendations, coordinate delivery and measure the plan's effectiveness against Deliveroo France's marketing and business objectives.

This is a hybrid role, based in Paris.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

1. Integrated Marketing Planning & Business Performance — France

  • Analyse business priorities, performance data, consumer insights and previous campaign results to identify opportunities and risks for the French market.

  • Lead France quarterly planning, from kick-off through approval of priorities, objectives and the calendar.

  • Translate central direction and French market needs into one coherent integrated 360° marketing plan.

  • Develop prioritisation recommendations and trade-off scenarios based on expected impact, capacity, investment and dependencies.

  • Partner with the relevant teams to define campaign objectives and KPIs, then feed campaign learnings into future plans.

  • Act as PMO for key marketing moments, including Back-to-School and Black Friday, and build the overarching narrative.

2. Orchestrating 360° Campaigns

  • Bring local and central teams together around a shared delivery plan and build integrated timelines.

  • Lead the localisation of global campaigns and align media plans with the mix defined by Brand Marketing, ensuring they are tailored to the French market.

  • Coordinate local campaigns and partner activations with the Promo & Partnerships teams.

  • Clarify ownership, dependencies, decision dates and success criteria; resolve friction and escalate issues requiring a trade-off decision.

3. Tracking, Performance & Governance

  • Track deliverables, analyse gaps against objectives and the France brief, and run coordination check-ins.

  • Maintain campaign documentation and prepare the memos required for decisions and trade-offs.

  • Ensure legal requirements and local market considerations are reflected.

  • Consolidate visibility over marketing investment, identify gaps or constraints that could affect the plan, and facilitate trade-off decisions with budget owners.

  • Run campaign reviews with Measurement teams, analyse results and turn learnings into recommendations for future plans.

4. Agencies & Partnerships

  • Consolidate and prioritise French market feedback for the Creative team, coordinate deadlines and ensure deliverables meet the France brief. The Creative team retains ownership of creative development and approval.

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for agencies on execution, deliverables and planning.

  • Coordinate major brand partnerships, such as Top Chef, with the Promo & Partnerships teams, media owners and relevant partners.

Ways of Working

  • Works across multiple functional teams without direct authority over most contributors, leading through influence.

  • Distinguishes what can be resolved independently from what requires escalation, and arbitrates competing local and central priorities.

  • Maintains visibility through one shared, up-to-date campaign calendar that serves as the reference point for all stakeholders.

Success in this role depends equally on the quality of relationships and the quality of organisation.

 

Key Skills

  • Strategic thinking, intellectual curiosity and business orientation, with the ability to understand complex topics quickly and connect marketing choices to market priorities and objectives.

  • Data fluency and strong analytical skills to interpret performance, challenge assumptions and make recommendations.

  • Integrated marketing planning and complex programme management, from setting priorities through 360° campaign execution.

  • Stakeholder management and influence in a matrix environment, with the ability to simplify complex topics and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.

  • Prioritisation, trade-off decision-making and operational rigour, including risk anticipation, agency management and dependency management.

Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 5–8 years of experience in integrated marketing, marketing planning, marketing strategy or marketing programme management, either client-side or in an agency.

  • Demonstrated experience turning business priorities and performance data into plans, trade-off scenarios and marketing recommendations.

  • Experience orchestrating 360° campaigns in a matrix environment, working with local teams, central teams and agencies.

  • Strong understanding of the main marketing levers, their contribution to business and brand objectives, and the French market.

Success Measures

  • One integrated 360° France marketing plan, aligned with business priorities and recognised as the reference point by local and central teams.

  • Data-driven recommendations and trade-off decisions based on expected impact and available capacity.

  • Clear campaign objectives and KPIs, with results analysed and applied to future plans.

  • Coherent 360° campaigns delivered without major surprises and with risks anticipated.

  • Local execution that contributes to Deliveroo France's marketing and business objectives.

  • Clear stakeholder visibility on priorities, risks, decisions and results.

Why This Role?

This role offers unique exposure to Deliveroo France's strategic marketing challenges, working directly with local leadership and central functional teams. It provides a strong platform for progression into broader Integrated Marketing responsibilities.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Thruster CAD and Stress Analyst
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

We want you as a talented CAD & Stress Analyst to help us in our mission by designing and structurally justifying the hardware that makes up our propulsion systems, with a particular focus on the Thrust Chamber Assembly(TCA). You will own parts from initial CAD layout through to final stress justification, working hand in hand with the manufacturing and test teams to bring flight hardware from concept to qualified design.

Key responsibilities

In your capacity as a CAD & Stress Analyst, you will be responsible for the on-time and on-cost design and structural justification of propulsion hardware, with the TCA as your primary scope.

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:

During the Design Phase:

  • Design the thrust chamber & injector propulsion hardware in CAD, from concept layout through to detailed design.

  • Perform stress analysis (hand calculations and FEA) on designed parts to substantiate margins of safety under mechanical, thermal and pressure loads.

  • Select materials and define manufacturing processes in coordination with manufacturing engineering, accounting for structural, thermal and producibility constraints.

  • Work closely with propulsion, thermal and fluidic system engineers to translate functional requirements into part-level design and load cases.

  • Establish and maintain interface definitions, drawings and part datasets, ensuring configuration control and traceability.

  • Conduct trade studies on design options (geometry, material, manufacturing route) and justify design decisions with analysis.

  • Elaborate and maintain structural analysis reports supporting design reviews and qualification.

  • Support the definition of test requirements needed to validate analytical models and structural assumptions.

  • Produce and maintain technical documentation of design choices and trade-offs, to a high standard, capturing analysis methods and results as to serve as reference justification for the design.

During Manufacturing, Assembly and Test Phase:

  • Support manufacturing and inspection of parts, resolving design or tolerance issues as they arise.

  • Support root-cause investigations of any structural anomaly or test finding, correlating analysis with hardware behaviour.

  • Update and correlate stress models and analyses based on test and inspection results.

  • Support design iterations and upgrades based on test campaign outcomes.

What we would love to see from you

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering or similar degrees.

  • Over 1 year of related experience in CAD design and stress analysis of mechanical or structural hardware, ideally in a propulsion, aerospace or high-reliability environment.

  • Strong CAD skills, able to take a part from concept to a fully detailed, manufacturable design.

  • Solid grounding in structural/stress analysis, including hand calculations and FEA (e.g. Ansys, Abaqus, or equivalent).

  • Familiarity with manufacturing processes (machining, additive manufacturing, welding/brazing) and their impact on design and structural performance.

  • Nice to have: CFD experience, for thermal or flow-related analysis of propulsion hardware.

  • Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across departments.

  • Fluency in English.

Skills and Behaviours

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done.

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.

  • Demonstrates behaviour consistent with The Exploration Company's core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

  • Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.
