jobs.title: Vikariat SO-lärare åk 6-9, Noblaskolan Lindholmen, Göteborg
jobs.description:
Noblaskolan består av 18 för- och grundskolor som arbetar enligt devisen att elever som utmanas når längre. Genom en kombination av tydliga strukturer, höga förväntningar, undervisning av hög kvalitet samt trygghet och studiero ska eleverna få de bästa förutsättningarna för en bra skolgång. Noblaskolan är en del av AcadeMedias grundskolor.

Vi söker nu en vikarie i samband med övergång vid rekrytering. Vi söker i första hand en legitimerad lärare i SO för årskurserna 6-9 med behörighet Samhällskunskap och Geografi.

Start i samband med höstlovet, vecka 44, eller enligt överenskommelse. Vikariat pågår fram till jullovet, vecka 51.

Vi söker dig som vet att lärande startar med relation.

På vår skola har vi höga ambitioner för våra elevers lärande och utveckling och vårt arbete präglas av ett gemensamt engagemang. Du är ödmjuk, har lätt för att samarbeta, når fram till kollegor och elever samt är trygg i din roll som lärare. Du lockas av att få varje elev att nå sin fulla potential och vågar anpassa din undervisning för att nå fler.  

Dina arbetsuppgifter

    Planera, genomföra och utvärdera undervisning tillsammans med ämneskollegor.
    Bidra aktivt till att skapa en trygg och motiverande lärandemiljö där varje elev känner sig sedd och hörd.
    Samarbeta nära med kollegor, specialpedagog och rektorer för att säkerställa elevernas utveckling.
    Du är en del av årskursens arbetslag, där ni tillsammans ansvarar för elevernas skoldag.

Övrigt

Du är varmt välkommen med din ansökan via vårt rekryteringssystem. Tillsättning kan komma att ske innan sista ansökningsdag. Vid frågor kring tjänsten, kontakta gärna rektor Malin Forsberg. malin.forsberg@noblaskolan.se

Vi undanbeder oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

jobs.title: Avdelingleder hjemmetjenesten
jobs.description:
Vil du være med å forme framtidens helsetjenester i Klepp kommune?

Klepp kommune har ambisjoner for utviklingen av framtidens helsetjenester. Vi står i et tydelig skifte der behovene øker, ressursene blir knappere, og kravene til samhandling, endring og bærekraft blir sterkere. Dette krever nye løsninger, nye arbeidsformer og tydelig ledelse.
Vi søker nå en avdelingsleder for hjemmetjenester  – en nøkkelrolle i utviklingen av helse- og omsorgstjenester for innbyggerne i Klepp.

Vil du bli avdelingsleder i hjemmetjenesten?

Vi ser etter en motivert og engasjert avdelingsleder i hjemmetjenesten. En leder som ønsker å skape gode tjenester sammen med dyktige medarbeidere. En som vil bidra til å videreutvikle hjemmetjenesten og sikre trygge og helsefremmende tjenester for innbyggerne våre.

Avdelingsleder inngår i virksomhetens ledergruppe og rapporterer til virksomhetsleder.


Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Budsjett-, økonomi-, personal- og fagansvar
  • Daglig drift av avdelingen, turnusplanlegging og ressursstyring av cirka 25 årsverk
  • Bidra til at tjenesten når mål og resultatkrav
  • Utvikle tjenesten i tråd med virksomhetsplan og sentrale og nasjonale føringer
  • Ansvar for at tjenesten utøves i samsvar med kvalitetskrav og lovverk
  • Samhandle tverrfaglig på tvers av avdelinger
  • Oppfølging og veiledning av ansatte, og utvikle/opprettholde et godt arbeidsmijlø
  • Rekruttering og opplæring av ansatte
Kvalifikasjonar
  • 3-årig helse og sosialfaglig høyskole (bachelor) 
  • Formell lederutdanning, eller påbegynt utdanning innen 2 år etter oppstart
  • Ledererfaring
  • Høy grad av økonomiforståelse og erfaring med budsjettansvar
  • Erfaring med endrings-og utviklingsarbeid
  • Kjenne til lovverk for tjenesteområdet
  • Ønskelig med erfaring innenfor helse
  • Ønskelig med erfaring i bruk av velferdsteknologi
  • Gode dokumentasjonsferdigheter
  • Beherske ulike systemer og dataverktøy
  • Beherske norsk godt, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Attester og vitnemål:
    Vi ber om at du laster opp attester og vitnemål i PDF-format samen med søknaden din.
Personlege eigenskapar
  • Gode lederegenskaper, en tydelig trygg og samlende leder
  • Kunne jobbe selvstendig og målretta
  • Stor arbeidskapasitet og er robust
  • Samarbeider og kommuniserer godt
  • God på relasjonsbygging og skape tillit
  • Pålitelig og ansvarsbevisst
  • Nærværende leder med evne til å inspirere og motivere
  • Evner å stå i kompleksitet og gjennomføre endringer
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.
Vi tilbyr
  • Faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Engasjert lederteam som samarbeider på tvers av avdelinger
  • Faglig dyktige, erfarne og engasjerte medarbeidere
  • Inkluderende arbeidsplass
  • Lønn etter avtale
  • Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger (https://www.klp.no/pensjon/offentlig-tjenestepensjon-kort-fortalt)
  • Gratis parkering
  • Gratis adgang i bassenget i Klepphallen, ved gitte tider
  • Bedriftskunstforening
  •  Ordning med refusjon for behandling hos fysioterapeut og kiropraktor

Ta gjerne kontakt for spørsmål og mer informasjon om stillingen.

KontaktinformasjonSigne Hagen, verksemdleiar, +47 98601664
ArbeidsstadOlav Hålands Veg 8
4351 Kleppe
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgivar: Klepp kommune

Referansenr.: 5180344303
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Fast
Søknadsfrist: 04.10.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Klepp er den største av kommunane på Jæren, med over 21 000 innbyggarar og om lag 1800  tilsette. Me ligg sentralt til, med korte avstander både til Stavanger, Sandnes og Bryne.

Kommunen vår har dei flottaste strendene i heile regionen, me har ein spennande kulturhistorie, og ei god blanding av landbruk, industri og varehandel.

Visjonen vår er «Med blikk for alle».  Me ønskjer tilsette som tek i eit tak, bryr seg og tenkjer fritt, og me oppmodar alle kvalifiserte til å søkja, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn.

Me gjer merksam på at søkarlister kan verta offentleggjort, sjølv om ein har bede om å bli unntatt offentlegheit. Søkar vil verta varsla før offentleggjering.

jobs.title: Teknisen dokumentaation ja projektihallinnon koordinaattori / Technical Document Controller and Project Team Administrator
jobs.description:
Etsimme nyt Haminan erinomaiseen projektitiimiimme oma-aloitteista ja järjestelmällistä
teknisen dokumentaation ja projektihallinnon koordinaattoria.
Pääset työskentelemään ainutlaatuisessa ja kansainvälisessä datakeskusympäristössä Haminassa. Kyseessä on kokoaikainen, toistaiseksi voimassa oleva tehtävä, joka edellyttää päivittäistä läsnäoloa kohteessamme Haminassa.
ISS Capital Projects-yksikkö on osa liikevaihdoltaan mitattuna yhtä suurinta liiketoimintayksikköämme, teollisuus ja tekniset palvelut, ja tuottaa asiantuntijapalveluita asiakkaidensa kriittisten toimintaympäristön kehittämiseen. Palvelun laadun varmistaa yrityksemme vahva osaaminen, joka kattaa kiinteistön koko elinkaaren. Organisaatiomme sisäinen yhteistyö mahdollistaa asiakkaallemme toimitilajohtamisen kokonaispalveluratkaisut joustavasti toteutettuna.
Tässä roolissa toimit päivittäin tiiviissä yhteistyössä sekä projektitiimin että asiakkaamme kanssa. Olet tiimin korvaamaton apu ja oikea käsi, joka varmistaa toiminnan sujuvuuden. Tässä tehtäväss vastaat projektin asianmukaisesta dokumentoinnista Google Workspace -ympäristössä ja kehität siihen liittyviä prosesseja. Päivität kokousmuistioita, tuet tiimiä ja varmistat, että projektit etenevät suunnitellusti. Hoidat käytännön asioita, kuten rahtitilauksia ja työlupien hallintaa työmaalla. Osallistut asiakkuuden jatkuvaan kehittämiseen ja tavoitteiden saavuttamiseen vastuullisella ja ammattimaisella otteella.
Onnistuaksesi tässä tehtävässä, odotamme sinulta positiivista asennetta sekä ammattimaista ja proaktiivista työotetta. Sinulla tulee olla tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. tradenomi tai insinööri) sekä aiempaa kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä (esim. suunnittelutoimistosta tai rakennustyömaalta). Olet työskentelyotteeltasi järjestelmällinen, oma-aloitteinen, tarkka ja aikaansaava. Sinulla on vahva osaaminen Google Workspace -ohjelmistoista. CAD/Revit-työkalujen perusteiden tuntemus katsotaan eduksi. Kommunikoit ja viestit sekä kansainvälisten että kotimaisten sidosryhmien kanssa luontevasti, tehokkaasti ja selkeästi englannin ja suomen kielellä.
Tarjoamme sinulle ainutlaatuisen ja mielenkiintoisen projektinjohtotehtävän erityisessä ja kansainvälisessä datakeskusympäristössä, osana erinomaista, mukavaa ja osaavaa tiimiämme. Työskentelet yhdessä tiimin kanssa laadukkaan palveluorganisaation sopimuksen mukaisesti, joka on tiiviisti integroitu asiakkaan päivittäiseen toimintaan ja mukautuu jatkuvasti ja asiakaslähtöisesti sen tarpeisiin ja vaatimuksiin.
Jos olet etsimämme henkilö, jätä meille hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta ja liitä mukaan CV:si mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 11.10.2026. Olemme sinuun pian yhteydessä!


-----------------


We are now looking for a proactive and systematic Document Controller and Project Team Administrator to join our excellent project team in Hamina.
You will get to work in a unique and international data center environment. This is a full-time, permanent position that requires daily presence on-site at our site in Hamina.

The ISS Capital Projects unit is part of our Industrial and Technical Services division, one of our largest business units by revenue. We provide expert services for the development of our clients critical operating environments. The quality of our service is ensured by our companys strong expertise, which covers the entire lifecycle of the property. The internal cooperation within our organization enables us to offer our clients flexible and comprehensive facility management solutions.
In this position, you will work in close daily cooperation with both the project team and our client. You will be the teams invaluable support and right hand, ensuring the smooth running of operations. Your responsibilities will include managing the projects official documentation within the Google Workspace environment and developing related processes. You will update meeting minutes, support the team, and ensure projects progress as planned. Handling practical matters such as freight orders and the management of work permits on-site is included in your daily responsibilities. will be participating in the continuous development of the client relationship and working towards our goals with a responsible and professional approach.
To succeed in this role, we expect you to have a positive attitude and a professional, proactive work ethic. This role requires a suitable higher education degree as well as a previous experience in similar roles (e.g., from a design office or a construction site organization). Your way of working is systematic, self-directed, meticulous, and productive. You have a strong proficiency with Google Workspace software. Basic knowledge of CAD/Revit tools is considered an advantage. You are able to communicate naturally, effectively, and clearly in both English and Finnish with international and domestic stakeholders.
We offer you a unique and interesting project role in a special and international data center environment, as part of our excellent, supportive, and skilled team. You will work with a team that is part of a high-quality service organization, tightly integrated into the clients daily operations and constantly adapting to their needs and requirements in a customer-focused way.
If you are the person we are looking for, please submit your application and CV via the link below as soon as possible, but no later than October 11, 2026. Look forward to hearing from you soon!


ISS is one of the worlds leading providers of integrated facility services. With 300,000 colleagues globally, and more than 7,300 in Finland, we focus on delivering the best facility services and creating the workplace that our customers dream of. The key word that binds us together is service. United by a commitment to exceptional service, we aim to create inclusive workplaces, foster innovation, and enhance company culture.

jobs.title: Ravintolapäällikkö, Amarillo, Break Sokos Hotel Flamingo
jobs.description:
Primary location:
VANTAA

Ravintolapäällikkö, Amarillo, Break Sokos Hotel Flamingo

Break Sokos Hotel Flamingo on elämyksellinen hotelli Pohjoismaiden suurimman viihdekeskuksen yhteydessä.

Nykyisen ravintolapäällikön siirtyessä uusiin haasteisiin yhtiön sisällä haemme ravintolapäällikköä vastaamaan Break Sokos Hotel Flamingon suositun ja menestyksekkään Amarillon ravintolatoiminnoista. Amarillo on yksi alueen vetovoimaisimmista ravintoloista, ja tehtävä tarjoaa ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden johtaa suurta ja näkyvää kokonaisuutta vahvan brändin alla.

Pääset työskentelemään yhdessä huipputiimin kanssa ja olemaan keskiössä luomassa asiakkaillemme unohtumattomia elämyksiä – tuloksellisesti ja kunnianhimoisesti.

Etsimme vahvaa tuloksen tekijää, joka on aidosti tulosnälkäinen ja innostuu tavoitteista, myynnin kasvattamisesta sekä erinomaisen asiakaskokemuksen kehittämisestä. Johdat tiimiäsi esimerkilläsi eturivistä ja osaat rakentaa sekä ylläpitää myynnillistä palvelukulttuuria, jossa jokainen tiimiläinen ymmärtää oman roolinsa tuloksen tekemisessä. Henkilöstön kehittäminen, valmentava johtaminen ja arjen sujuva organisointi ovat sinulle luontevia, ja osallistut itsekin operatiiviseen työhön.

Ravintolapäällikkönä vastaat toiminnan laadusta ja kannattavuudesta sekä olet aktiivinen kehittäjä, joka vie toimintaa rohkeasti eteenpäin. Tehtävässä toimit osana hotellin johtoryhmää. Työ on vaihtelevaa vuorotyötä.

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE:

Vahvan tuen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön
Avainroolin ja mahdollisuuden olla mukana kehittämässä toimintaa
Mahdollisuuden oppia, kehittyä ja laajentaa omaa osaamista
S-ryhmän kattavat henkilöstöedut, tulospalkkiojärjestelmän ja uramahdollisuudet jatkossa

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA:
Tulosnälkäistä ja tavoitteellista johtamisotetta
Kykyä innostaa, valmentaa ja sitouttaa tiimi huipputuloksiin
Vahvaa myynnillisen palvelukulttuurin johtamista
Aktiivista myynnin ja kannattavuuden seurantaa sekä kustannusten hallintaa
Erinomaista organisointikykyä vilkkaassa ravintolaympäristössä
Asiakaslähtöistä ja ratkaisukeskeistä asennetta
Kokemusta ravintola-alan operatiivisesta esihenkilötyöstä
Esimerkillä johtamista ja valmiutta osallistua myös operatiiviseen työhön
Hyvää ravintolaliiketoiminnan ja tuloksellisen toiminnan ymmärrystä

Lisätietoja ja hakuohjeet

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.
Jos innostuit, täytä hakemus palkkatoiveineen viimeistään 11.10.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja kutsumme henkilöitä haastatteluun jo hakuaikana, joten ethän aikaile. Emme huomioi sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa hotellinjohtaja Martin Andergård puhelimitse numerosta 050-3883350 tai sähköpostitse martin.andergard@sok.fi.

Eezy Oyj toimii Sokotelin virallisena rekrytointikumppanina hoitaen rekrytoinnin ensimmäiset vaiheet. Työllistyt osaksi S-ryhmää Sokotelille vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

SokotelOy on osa S-ryhmää. Me operoimme Suomessa neljäätoista Sokos Hotels -ketjun hotellia ja kahdeksaa Radisson Hotels -ketjun hotellia. Sokotel Oy toimii pääkaupunkiseudulla, Tampereella ja Oulussa.

jobs.title: Utbildad barnskötare (100%) till Fröhuset förskola, Pysslingen Förskolor i
jobs.description:
Utbildad barnskötare (100%) till Fröhuset förskola, pysslingen Förskolor i Östersund

Vill du arbeta på en förskola där nyfikenheten är vår främsta drivkraft, där våra val kring lärmiljöer och material är av stor betydelse och där varje möte räknas? Vi söker nu en engagerad och utbildad barnskötare tillsvidare  på 100 % som vill utvecklas och lära tillsammans med oss.

Vår filosofi – Kraften i tillsammans

Vår verksamhet bygger på en värdebaserad organisation där välkomnande, olikhet, delaktighet och hållbarhet är bärande begrepp. Vi är starkt inspirerade av förskolorna i den italienska staden Reggio Emilia och verkar för en hållbar framtid genom påhittighet och handlingskraft. Hos oss är förskolan en kreativ plats i ständig förändring – utvecklande för oss alla barn och pedagoger. Stor nyfikenhet är nyckeln i allt vi gör och vi tror på kraften i att göra saker tillsammans.

Vi ser oss som medforskare och reflekterande praktiker som ständigt utvecklas i ett lärande där barn, familjer och pedagoger samarbetar.

Om vår miljö, materialet och måltiden

Hos oss är lärmiljöerna och materialet noggrant utvalda för att väcka barnens utforskarglädje, kreativitet och samarbete. Miljön är föränderlig och formas utifrån barnens intressen och behov.

Måltiden är en central del av vår pedagogiska dag. Vi har ett eget kök som arbetar aktivt med ansvarsfull gastronomi. För oss innebär det ett starkt fokus på hållbara val och att lägga grunden för en hälsosam och hållbar relation till maten och måltidssituationen som en social mötesplats.

Som en del av Pysslingen Förskolor (och därmed AcadeMedia) är du med och förverkligar vårt erbjudande: "En trygg och stimulerande värld full av möjligheter".

Om rollen

Som barnskötare hos oss är du en aktiv del av vår pedagogiska verksamhet. Du drivs av öppenhet, glädje och ett aktivt lyssnande till barnen, där pedagogisk dokumentation och reflektion är våra viktigaste verktyg. Du ser hur barn lär på olika sätt och har förmågan att utmana dem genom lek, fantasi och i alla vardagssituationer. Du skapar starka relationer till både barn, kollegor och vårdnadshavare och sätter alltid uppdraget i fokus.

Det här söker vi hos dig

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du uppfyller följande profil:

Formella krav och kompetenser

    

Utbildning: Godkänd barnskötarutbildning (gymnasie- eller vuxenutbildning).

    

Erfarenhet av arbete i förskola

    

Språk: Goda kunskaper i det svenska språket, där du uttrycker dig väl i både tal och skrift.

Vi söker dig som:

    

Har uppdraget i fokus samt är trygg i förskolans läroplan och styrdokument.

    

Drivs av en stor inneboende nyfikenhet, är medforskande och vill lära dig samt se varje dag som ett lärorikt äventyr tillsammans med barnen och kollegorna.

    

Möter din omgivning med glädje och entusiasm, är inlyssnande, respektfull och anser att varje möte är betydelsefullt.

    

Har en god förmåga att samarbeta, är initiativtagande och nyfiken.

    

Är handlingskraftig, strukturerad och kvalitetsmedveten i ditt arbete.

    

Kan arbeta med digitala verktyg och använda dem som ett naturligt inslag i den pedagogiska dokumentationen.

    

Har en professionell inställning och både ger och tar emot feedback på ett konstruktivt sätt.

Det här erbjuder vi dig

Vi erbjuder en strukturerad, stimulerande och glädjefylld arbetsplats där du får:

    

Gemensam planering i arbetslaget samt tillgång till ett nära ledningsteam.

    

Tydlig struktur och uppföljning i det systematiska kvalitetsarbetet.

    

Fria pedagogiska måltider (lagade från grunden med fokus på hållbarhet), tillgång till arbetskläder för utomhusvistelse och friskvårdsbidrag.

    

Reflektionsdagar samt tillgång till AcadeMedias förmånswebb.

Övrig information och ansökan

    

Anställningsform: Tillsvidare

    

Omfattning: 100 %.

    

Arbetstid: Arbetstiden är schemalagd under förskolans öppettider.

    

Tillträdesdag: Januari 2027.

    

Sista ansökningsdag: 25/10 -26

    

Tjänsten är placerad i Östersund

Låter det som ett jobb för dig?

Välkommen med din ansökan innehållande CV och personligt brev där du beskriver varför du passar för just denna tjänst och vår verksamhet.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan! Klicka på knappen "Sök tjänsten" nedan för att registrera din ansökan i vårt system.

Kontakt

Om du har frågor är du välkommen att kontakta biträdande rektor Sara Djusberg på telefon 076 - 107 58 67 eller e-post sara.djusberg@pysslingen.se

Viktigt! Belastningsregister

Inom förskolan måste du enligt lag visa upp ett utdrag från belastningsregistret. Beställ gärna detta redan idag via polisen.se, då handläggningstiden vanligtvis är cirka två veckor.

Vi har gjort vårt medieval för denna rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller säljare av andra rekryteringstjänster.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Intensive Care Nurse for the ICU, Torsby Hospital
jobs.description:
We are looking for a dedicated Intensive Care (ICU) Nurse to join Torsby Hospital and work in a stimulating environment characterized by close collaboration and short decision-making paths. We are now looking for a new colleague to join our Intensive Care Unit (ICU) – someone who wants to be part of a committed team where we value one another and are passionate about making a difference every day.

About the position

We are looking for an ICU Nurse for a full-time position (100%).

As an ICU Nurse, you will provide advanced care to patients with a wide range of diagnoses and with threatened or confirmed failure of vital functions. In this role, you will monitor vital parameters and, when necessary, respond to changes in the patient's condition.

You will work as part of a team together with an assistant nurse and an anaesthesiologist. If a patient's condition changes during your shift, you will support one another and work together as a team. The work is varied and challenging and provides opportunities for continuous learning every day.

Your skills and qualifications

We are looking for a registered nurse with at least three years of professional experience in intensive care, or a relevant specialist qualification in intensive care.

Personal qualities are important to us. We are looking for someone who is confident, reliable, and highly motivated. You are able to work independently, take initiative, and are prepared to act based on your professional assessment.

We value strong teamwork and communication skills, flexibility, and a strong commitment to quality. You are proactive and eager to contribute to the continued development of our services.

Your benefits as an employee

At Region Värmland, we have an important mission. We are here to help everyone in Värmland live healthy and fulfilling lives. As your employer, we therefore make sure to support and take care of you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

All our employees are entitled to at least 25 days of annual leave. As a new employee, you also earn paid vacation from your first day of employment. We offer more vacation days than required by Swedish law. We provide opportunities for learning and professional development as part of your daily work. We support you as an employee and create conditions for financial security throughout your working life. We offer attractive benefits and various insurance policies. Flexible working hours are available in most of our departments.

We share knowledge, experience, and clear strategies to help you manage new challenges and quickly integrate into Swedish society. We also assist you and your family with the relocation and settlement process.

Read more at New to Värmland – Ny i Värmland - nyivarmland.se

Your workplace

Torsby Hospital is a small hospital in northern Värmland with a big heart for our patients and employees. We consider every employee and every department important in ensuring high-quality care for our patients.

We are known for excellent collaboration between our different departments, short decision-making paths, and close contact with hospital management.

Our Intensive Care Unit (ICU) consists of ICU nurses, registered nurses, and assistant nurses. We have a positive working environment, take pride in our work, and value one another. We offer an individually tailored induction programme based on your experience and needs.

Torsby – Small in size, big on quality of life

Torsby is an ideal place for anyone who appreciates the tranquillity of nature combined with a strong sense of community and good services throughout the municipality. Here, you can enjoy all the advantages of a smaller town while having excellent opportunities for a relaxed lifestyle in beautiful surroundings.

Read more about life in Torsby here: Torsby ENG - Värmland

jobs.title: Responsable Systèmes d'Information & Outils internes H/F
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers.

Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, nos solutions s’imposent aujourd’hui comme des références sur le   marché :

N2F : gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs)

Keeple : gestion RH du quotidien (congés, absences, temps de travail)

L’entreprise est en forte croissance avec une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Notre écosystème d’outils s’est construit progressivement avec la croissance de l’entreprise. Il est aujourd’hui riche mais encore insuffisamment structuré :

  • des outils qui ne communiquent pas toujours efficacement entre eux

  • des données encore partiellement silotées

  • certains processus insuffisamment maîtrisés

  • un potentiel d’automatisation et d’usage de l’IA encore peu exploité

Certaines briques sont déjà portées en interne, mais de manière partielle ou trop manuelle.

Nous créons ce poste pour structurer durablement le SI, fiabiliser les flux et accompagner la montée en maturité de l’organisation.

Ton rôle

Rattaché au CTO, tu interviens de manière transverse sur l’ensemble de l’entreprise.

Le poste est volontairement hybride : à la fois stratégique et opérationnel. L’objectif n’est pas uniquement de piloter, mais de comprendre, structurer et mettre en œuvre.

Tu travailles en lien étroit avec le CODIR et les équipes métiers.

Tes responsabilités

Structuration du SI et des flux

  • Cartographier les outils et les flux existants

  • Identifier les points de friction et les incohérences

  • Structurer la circulation de la donnée (clients, prospects, finance…)

  • Concevoir et faire évoluer les intégrations entre les systèmes

L’objectif est d’éliminer les silos et de fiabiliser les échanges de données.

Reprise en main des sujets critiques

  • Monter en compétence sur les outils clés, notamment la facturation

  • Fiabiliser les processus existants

  • Réduire la dépendance aux tâches manuelles via l’automatisation

Pilotage de l’écosystème outils

  • Recueillir et challenger les besoins des équipes métiers

  • Définir une logique cohérente d’évolution du SI

  • Arbitrer entre amélioration de l’existant et mise en place de nouveaux outils

  • Piloter les projets SI de bout en bout

Management d’équipe

  • Encadrer une équipe de 3 développeurs

  • Prioriser les sujets en fonction des enjeux business

  • Structurer le backlog et assurer l’alignement avec les besoins de l’entreprise

Développement des usages IA

  • Identifier des cas d’usage concrets avec les équipes

  • Prototyper et déployer des solutions

  • Accompagner l’adoption


Ce que tu apportes

  • 6 à 10 ans d’expérience en SI applicatif, Business Systems ou équivalent

  • Une expérience en environnement SaaS (idéalement dans des structures de 200 à 500 personnes)

  • Une bonne maîtrise des problématiques d’intégration et de flux de données (API, webhooks, synchronisation)

  • Une capacité à comprendre, challenger et structurer un écosystème d’outils dans sa globalité

  • Une expérience avec des outils d’automatisation (Make, Zapier, n8n ou équivalent)

  • Une expérience en management d’équipe technique

  • Une capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec des interlocuteurs métiers variés

Ce poste n’est pas adapté si

  • tu es très orienté(e) grands groupes avec des SI lourds et peu agiles

  • tu recherches un rôle purement stratégique sans implication opérationnelle

  • ton expertise est principalement orientée sécurité (ce périmètre est couvert par un autre rôle)

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Une entreprise SaaS solide avec des fondamentaux rares, qui combine croissance soutenue et rentabilité

  • Tu arrives à un moment clé où beaucoup reste à structurer pour passer un cap, avec déjà une base existante

  • Une proximité avec la direction, un bon niveau d’autonomie et des cycles de décision rapides

  • Un rôle avec un impact visible rapidement, aussi bien sur les équipes que sur les résultats

  • Des sujets variés et concrets, entre structuration du SI et montée en gamme

  • Une équipe accessible, impliquée et orientée résultats

Poste basé à Montagnat (01) avec présence attendue 2 jours par semaine.

jobs.title: Développeur fullstack confirmé H/F (C#, .Net, Angular)
jobs.description:
À propos de N2JSoft

N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays, faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français.

N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante, etc.

L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes.

Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 220 aujourd’hui, portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale.

Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs.

En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple, un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste).

Nous prévoyons de recruter 100 nouveaux collaborateurs d’ici 2027. Notre objectif est également d’accélérer la croissance de nos produits, ce qui passe par le renforcement de notre équipe de développement.

Quelques chiffres

jobs.title: Driftsoperatør på farvesorteringsanlæg i Aalborg
jobs.description:
Er du typen, der tager ansvar, møder til tiden og kan lide både drift, teknik og praktiske opgaver? 
Så er du måske vores nye driftsoperatør.

Meldgaard Miljø A/S har siden 14. juli 2024 drevet et farvesorteringsanlæg i Aalborg for Nordværk på en 18-årig kontrakt. Anlægget sorterer grønne og sorte poser med henholdsvis madaffald og restaffald ved hjælp af optiske sensorer. Restaffald sendes til forbrænding hos Nordværk, mens madaffaldet afhentes af Nordværk til videre udnyttelse. Anlægget har en kapacitet på 58.000 tons årligt og modtager minimum 42.000 tons.


Om jobbet

Der er er tale om en stilling som driftsoperatør på vores farvesorteringsanlæg i Aalborg, hvor arbejdsstedet er Troensevej 2P, Aalborg Ø.

Du bliver en del af et team på 3-4 operatører, som arbejder tæt sammen med driftsleder og produktionsleder om den daglige drift af vores sorteringsanlæg. Du skal være med til at sikre kontinuerlig og optimal drift af farvesorteringsanlægget, hvor en del af dagen foregår i kontrolrummet.

Arbejdsopgaver

  • Overvågning af anlægget fra kontrolrum

  • Håndtering af mindre driftsstop og alarmer

  • Fjernelse af fastsiddende materiale

  • Truckkørsel

  • Kørsel af restaffald fra sorteringsanlægget til forbrændingsanlægget ved Nordværk

  • Rengøring af maskiner og arbejdsområder

  • Skrabning og vask af gulve

  • Smøring af lejer og lettere vedligehold

  • Ad hoc-opgaver i produktionen

Om dig

Erfaring fra produktion, lager, landbrug, genbrug eller lignende er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du er ansvarlig, lærevillig og har lyst til at være en del af et hold, der får tingene til at fungere

Det er samtidig vigtigt at du:

  • Mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har teknisk forståelse og lyst til at lære nyt

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage initiativ

  • Ikke er bange for fysisk arbejde

  • Trives med praktiske opgaver

  • Har IT erfaring på brugerniveau 

  • Truckcertifikat er en fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Lastbilkørekort er en fordel, da vi løbende transporterer restaffald fra sorteringsanlægget til forbrændingsanlægget.

  • Har højt humør og er positiv

Mulighed for mere teknisk ansvar:
Vi søger ikke nødvendigvis en uddannet mekaniker. Til gengæld ser vi gerne, at du har praktisk flair og interesse 
for teknik. For den rette person er der mulighed for gradvist at få flere vedligeholdsopgaver såsom udskiftning af 
elmotorer, underbåndsruller, filtre og øvrige mekaniske opgaver på anlægget.

Vi tilbyder 

  • Fast daghold kl. 06.00-14.00 eller 07.00-15.00

    • Anlægget modtager affald alle årets dage, og der kan derfor være behov for arbejde på enkelte helligdage, særligt når dagrenovationen indsamles.

  • Grundig oplæring

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • Gode kolleger og uformel omgangstone

  • Mulighed for at udvikle tekniske og mekaniske kompetencer

  • En stabil arbejdsplads med fokus på miljø og genanvendelse

Hos Meldgaard kan vi tilbyde en spændende og udfordrende stilling med gode løn- og ansættelsesforhold i en velkonsolideret familievirksomhed med over 55 års erfaring. Vores omgangstone er åben og uformel, og der er frihed under ansvar med korte kommandoveje. 

Har du uddybende spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte driftsleder Vidar P. Pedersen på 
tlf. 6012 3040. Eller send os din ansøgning via Ansøg senest den 23. oktober 2026.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og afslutter processen når den rette kandidat er fundet. Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

jobs.title: Pædagogisk medarbejder til Birkestuen – vil du være en del af Langekær?
jobs.description:
Vi har sagt farvel til vores trofaste pædagogmedhjælper – heldigvis af den allerbedste grund: Hun har fået lyst til endnu mere pædagogik og er startet på pædagoguddannelsen.

Derfor mangler vi nu en ny kollega på 37 timer til Birkestuen, hvor 12 skønne vuggestuebørn og to erfarne kolleger glæder sig til at tage imod dig.

Vi er åbne for både dig, der er uddannet pædagog, og dig, der gerne vil arbejde som pædagogmedhjælper. Det vigtigste for os er ikke din titel – men hvem du er, hvad du kommer med, og at du har lyst til at skabe en rigtig god hverdag for vores børn.

Vi leder efter dig, der…

… kan se det store i de små øjeblikke.

Dig, der har lyst til at sidde på gulvet, være med i legen, synge den samme sang for 117. gang og samtidig være nysgerrig på, hvorfor vi gør, som vi gør – og om vi kan gøre det endnu bedre.

Vi håber, at du:

  • har lyst til at skabe trygge, udviklende og sjove dage for vores 12 vuggestuebørn
  • møder børnene med nærvær, omsorg og nysgerrighed
  • har lyst til at være en aktiv del af legen og de pædagogiske aktiviteter
  • trives med struktur, tydelig organisering og små børnegrupper
  • tør komme med idéer og samtidig er nysgerrig på dine kollegers perspektiver
  • har lyst til faglig udvikling og ikke bliver træt af at være nysgerrig på vores pædagogiske praksis
  • ser forældrene som vigtige samarbejdspartnere
  • har lyst til at være en del af et hus, hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs.

Om du har mange års erfaring eller er helt ny i faget, er ikke afgørende. Vi tager dig godt i hånden og sørger for, at du bliver klædt ordentligt på til at blive en del af Birkestuen og resten af Langekær.

Hvem er vi?

Børnehuset Langekær er et børnehus med to vuggestuegrupper og to børnehavegrupper.

Vi er et hus med høj faglighed, men også med plads til grin, skøre idéer og forskellige perspektiver. Vi tror på, at den gode pædagogiske kvalitet skabes sammen – og at det altid er de voksne, der har ansvaret for at justere rammerne, når et barn har brug for noget andet.

Hos os arbejder vi blandt andet med små grupper, tydelig voksenpositionering, struktur, visuel understøttelse og løbende evaluering af vores pædagogiske praksis.

Vi vil gerne udvikle os. Også når noget allerede fungerer godt.

Derfor leder vi efter en kollega, der har lyst til at være med på nyt, stille spørgsmål, prøve noget af og sammen med os være nysgerrig på:

Hvad giver det her egentlig børnene?

Vi er samtidig uddannelseshus og har løbende pædagogstuderende hos os. Det betyder noget for os at være et sted, hvor man kan lære – uanset om man er studerende, ny medarbejder eller har været i faget i 20 år.

Hverdagen i Langekær

Vi bruger vores legeplads og nærmiljø rigtig meget og er ude året rundt.

Vi arbejder med fælles temaer og årshjul, men vi tror ikke på pædagogik, der kun findes i en aktivitetsplan. Pædagogikken lever også i garderoben, ved frokostbordet, på puslebordet, i sandkassen og i det øjeblik, hvor et barn har brug for en voksen, der lige sætter sig ned.

Og så er vi ét hus. Du bliver ansat på Birkestuen, men du bliver kollega med hele Langekær.

Måske er det dig, vi mangler?

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele på forhånd.

Du skal have lyst til børnene, til fællesskabet og til at udvikle dig sammen med os.

Til gengæld lover vi, at du bliver taget godt imod af erfarne kolleger, som gerne deler ud af deres viden – og som også gerne vil høre, hvad du kommer med.

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen med opstart den 1. januar 2027.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så vent ikke nødvendigvis til sidste øjeblik med at sende din ansøgning.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Daglig leder Katrine Jensen
Tlf. 72 59 66 75
Katrine.Jensen@egekom.dk

ℹ️ Det praktiske

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Der indhentes børne- og straffeattest i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Egedal Kommune er en røgfri arbejdsplads og arbejder aktivt for ligestilling. Alle kvalificerede ansøgere opfordres til at søge uanset alder, køn, religion, handicap eller etnisk baggrund.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig – og måske byde dig velkommen på Birkestuen og i Langekær.

jobs.title: IT Security Specialist
jobs.description:
Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.



Your role

We are seeking a highly organized and relationship-driven IT Security Specialist to join our team at Business Area Surveillance. As an IT Security Specialist at Saab, you will work in an international context where advanced security threats, complex IT environments and high-impact business projects are part of the everyday business.

In this role, you will ensure the technical effectiveness of our Security Management System (SMS) by defining and validating the controls that secure our environment. You will be responsible for modernizing our technical oversight and bridging the gap between compliance requirements and operational reality. Acting as the primary lead for technical security validation, you will work closely with IT to provide the necessary oversight and ensure robust risk mitigation throughout the IT system lifecycle.



Your main tasks will be:

    Translate SMS and security requirements into technical standards, guidelines, and specifications.
    Turn security policies into practical technical solutions and secure system designs.
    Oversee the implementation of security controls across the IT lifecycle.
    Drive requirements for automation and digital tools to improve security monitoring and compliance.
    Validate technical compliance through reviews, audits, scans, and configuration assessments.
    Perform threat modeling and technical risk assessments to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities.
    Partner with architects and system owners to ensure security by design.
    Act as the technical security expert, providing guidance and supporting risk-based decisions.



Preferred locations for this role are Solna/Stockholm or Kallebäck/Göteborg.



Your profile

Personal qualities are of paramount importance for this role. We are looking for someone with unwavering integrity, strong ethics, and a high level of trustworthiness. You should possess the ability to build and cultivate strong professional networks and relationships, both internally and externally.

You are a self-starter who can work independently while remaining a collaborative team player, always maintaining a focus on business and the collective result. Finally, you must have a mature understanding of "balanced security" - the ability to implement robust security measures that enable, rather than hinder, a business-driven environment.



Required skills:

    University degree and/or relevant experience in IT security, cybersecurity, computer science, or a related field.
    Experience translating security frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST 800-171, and/or KSF (Försvarsmaktens krav på säkerhetsfunktioner) into technical baselines and standards.
    Experience conducting technical risk assessments, threat modeling, and vulnerability analysis.
    Strong understanding of secure system design, networking, and security architecture.
    Ability to analyze technical findings and convert them into actionable remediation plans.
    Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security matters to both technical and non-technical stakeholders in Swedish and English.



Desired skills:

    Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CISA.
    Experience with cloud security, containerization, and microservice environments.
    Experience from the defense industry, government authorities, or global organizations.
    Knowledge of security tools such as vulnerability scanners, SIEM, and IAM solutions.
    Experience with DevSecOps, automation, and continuous compliance monitoring.
    Experience leading technical security initiatives or projects.



This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.



What you will be a part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

At BeeHealthy, we're on a mission to make care smarter through our configurable, white-label SaaS platform. We combine over 115 years of healthcare expertise with modern technology, serving social, healthcare, and veterinary providers alongside insurance organisations in over 10 countries across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

We're a team of 90+, with 60+ in our product organisation, growing fast and looking for people who want to do meaningful work. If you care about impact, quality, and building products that genuinely improve how care is delivered and received, we'd love to hear from you.

You will own the what and the why for your product area, from discovery through launch and iteration. You will work closely with Engineering and Design to turn strategy into a clear product direction, make the tough calls on scope and tradeoffs, and ensure teams build the right things. This role is a strong fit for someone with a technical background who wants to build product in healthcare: a regulated, complex industry that runs on both B2B and B2C dynamics at once.

We are a company of about 100 people, and everyone here operates with a business owner mindset. Even at senior level, this role stays hands-on: you are accountable for the outcome, not just the output, and you build alongside the team rather than direct from a distance.

What you will do
Own the product strategy for your area, contributing to the bigger goal of making healthcare smarter
Stay on top of market knowledge, competitors, and the wider healthcare structure, so your decisions hold up commercially, not just technically
Run the end-to-end product management process for your domain, from discovery to delivery to feedback loops
Build strong working relationships across engineering, design, and commercial teams, turning customer insight into a roadmap the whole group can align behind
Work as a technical partner to engineering: understand the trade-offs, and use that understanding to push for product decisions that add real user value, not just ship features
Build compliance into the product from the start, working with frameworks like GDPR, MDR, EHDS, and national health data regulations, so requirements don't cost you rework or slip your timelines later

What you bring
5+ years in product management at a SaaS company, ideally already at senior level
Real comfort working close to engineering: APIs, integrations, platform architecture. Prior experience on a core platform team or in a highly technical environment is a strong plus
Solid product management craft, with experience in B2B
University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
A natural team player: humble, hands-on, high energy, drawn to solving problems rather than just describing them
Fluent English, with the ability to express yourself clearly and present confidently to different audiences

Bonus points
Background in Fintech, Healthcare, or Gambling/Gaming, or another complex, highly regulated industry
Experience across B2B2C environments; direct experience building or significantly evolving a CRM platform is a strong plus
Experience in a scale-up
Exposure to healthcare products such as Epic/MyChart or similar patient portal / EHR platforms
Experience with authentication or identity systems (OIDC, SAML, OAuth 2.0)
International experience, having worked across multiple markets or countries
German, Italian, Spanish, Arabic, or other languages

Benefits
Generous, Nordic-style paid holiday
Flexible remote-work policy and working hours
Wide range of IT equipment to choose from
Comprehensive occupational healthcare
Sponsored sports or culture memberships
Healthy snacks, and drinks at the office
Regular team days, game nights, and social events

Culture at BeeHealthy
At BeeHealthy, freedom and responsibility go hand in hand. You'll be trusted to work independently while collaborating closely with your colleagues, sharing knowledge, learning continuously, and respecting each other both professionally and personally.
Our culture is guided by strong values:
Skill and Knowledge: we never stop learning.
Caring and Responsibility: we look out for each other and the people who use what we build.
Partners and Entrepreneurship: we innovate through collaboration.
Growth and Development: we're committed to unlocking potential, both for ourselves and our customers.

We're a close-knit, international team where talent and knowledge-sharing thrive. We believe that building great healthcare technology starts with taking care of the people who build it.

Recruitment process
We read every application: Once the application period closes, we take time to review everyone who applied. You'll hear back from us, whatever the outcome.
Short meeting with our VP Talent: A chance to get to know each other. The focus here is on bringing BeeHealthy's culture and values to life, and exploring how they resonate with your own.

Apply by submitting your CV and a brief note about why this role excites you through our recruitment system by 18.10.2026. We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to hearing from you. Work starts per agreement.

jobs.title: PhD student in ultrafast spectroscopy of organic semiconductors
jobs.description:
We are looking to recruit a PhD researcher in the group of Dr. Gillett in the Electronic and Photonic Materials division in the Department of Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (IFM). The successful applicant will work in collaboration with the Swedish company Epishine AB on a research project funded by the Åforsk Foundation that will use ultrafast optical spectroscopy to understand the degradation mechanisms of organic photovoltaics. The recruited researcher will also have the opportunity to take advantage of the state-of-the-art spectroscopy setups developed in the group to pursue their own research interests more broadly in the field of organic materials. Topics currently being studied in the group include organic photovoltaic and OLED systems, vibronic coupling in organic molecules, molecular photoswitches, circularly polarized luminescence, and photocatalysis.

Your work assignments

This project aims to understand the stability and failure mechanisms in the light-absorbing layer of organic photovoltaic devices under conditions relevant to commercial applications. To achieve this, we will take a unique approach that involves using ultrafast optical spectroscopy techniques to probe how material degradation impacts the fundamental photophysics of the organic materials that underpin device operation (see https://doi.org/10.1016/j.joule.2023.03.002 for a recent example of this approach from the group). This project will be carried out in collaboration with the Swedish company Epishine AB (https://www.epishine.com/), also based in Linköping, who are currently working on the commercialization of organic photovoltaics for indoor light harvesting applications.

You will be responsible for performing transient absorption spectroscopy measurements, spanning the visible to mid-infrared, on organic photovoltaic samples provided by Epishine AB to understand how the photophysics of these materials change after different material degradation protocols. This will be supplemented by steady-state spectroscopy measurements (UVVis, photoluminescence/PLQY, FTIR), as well as morphology and computational characterization through collaborators, to provide a complete picture of the degradation mechanism under real-world conditions. Through this, you will provide new design rules for organic photovoltaic materials that will have a direct impact on commercial applications of the technology.

In addition, Dr. Gillett strongly encourages his research group to follow their curiosity and develop their own research projects. Therefore, the successful candidate will also have the freedom to explore other topics during their PhD within the broader fields of organic materials and ultrafast spectroscopy. Through this, you will have the opportunity to develop as an independent researcher ready to pursue an academic or industrial career path.

As a PhD student, you devote most of your time to doctoral studies and the research projects of which you are part. Your work may also include teaching or other departmental duties, up to a maximum of 20 per cent of full-time.

Your qualifications

You have graduated at Master’s level in Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, or related discipline, or completed courses with a minimum of 240 credits, at least 60 of which must be in advanced courses. Alternatively, you have gained essentially corresponding knowledge in another way.

In addition, the following are requirements for the role:

    Previous experience working with organic or perovskite materials.
    A high level of self-motivation and independence, good problem-solving skills, and the demonstrated ability to work in a team.
    The ability to fluently communicate in English (written and spoken).

The following requirements are not essential, but considered highly beneficial for the role:

    Previous experience working on organic photovoltaic materials and devices, including stability measurements
    Experience of independently performing ultrafast optical spectroscopy measurements, including, but not limited to, transient absorption and time-resolved photoluminescence
    Experience of working with laser systems, in particular femtosecond and nanosecond pulsed laser sources
    Good coding skills (e.g. Python, MATLAB, LabView) for the development of custom code for running experiments and analysing experimental data

Finally, a letter of intent should be attached to the application covering how your background and skills make you a good match for the research project on organic photovoltaics. In addition, please provide a short description of your own research interests and a potential idea for another research project that you would like to explore in the group. Note that this doesn’t necessarily have to be in the area of organic photovoltaics.

Your workplace

You will be employed in the research group led by Dr. Alexander Gillett (https://liu.se/en/employee/alegi69), located in the Electronic and Photonic Materials Division: https://liu.se/en/organisation/liu/ifm/efm. Here, you will be part of a small (currently the PI and ~5 researchers) and supportive team where the freedom to think critically and define your own research path is strongly encouraged.

The employment

When taking up the post, you will be admitted to the program for doctoral studies.

The employment has a duration of normally four years’ full-time equivalent. Extension of employment up to five years is based on the degree of teaching and institutional assignment. Further extensions may be granted in exceptional circumstances. You will initially be employed for one year, after which your employment will be renewed for a maximum of two years at a time, depending on your progress through the study plan.

Starting date by agreement.

Salary and employment benefits

The salary of PhD students is determined according to a locally negotiated salary progression.

Application procedure

Apply for the position by clicking the “Apply” button. Your application must reach Linköping University no later than 5th of October 2026.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Senior lecturer in dairy cow management
jobs.description:
Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and Animal Science

The Department of Applied Animal Science and Welfare

Our aim is to advance responsible animal management, welfare, and sustainable food production while ensuring high product quality. Through research and education, we focus on feed and nutrition, management and environment, ethology and animal ethics, as well as animal welfare and protection.

Subject description

The subject focuses on how the housing and management of dairy cows affect their health, welfare and productivity, as well as the sustainability of dairy production. It also covers the interactions between animals, their environment, technology and people at both farm and system levels.

Duties

The applicant will be responsible for developing research and teaching within the subject area, in collaboration with other researchers at the faculty and across the university. The successful candidate will also contribute to the development of teaching and learning within the subject area.

The research can be based on controlled experiments as well as production data from commercial farms, questionnaire-based studies and modelling.

The applicant will be expected to:

    develop and lead internationally successful research;
    develop, lead and participate in teaching at first, second and third cycle level;
    primarily teach within animal sciences, in addition to other components at first, second and third cycle level covering the subject;
    develop and maintain national and international networks with academia, the relevant public authorities, industry, organisations and society at large;
    collaborate with other SLU research teams to strengthen interdisciplinary activities at the university;
    apply for external research funding from both national and international sources;
    supervise doctoral students;
    contribute to the strategic development of the department, faculty and SLU;
    communicate research findings and other relevant information to society at large;
    be able to teach in Swedish within four years;
    be able to participate in discussions with colleagues and stakeholders in the sector, as well as carry out administrative duties in Swedish, within four years.

The department uses Swedish and English in parallel. The senior lecturer should be able to perform the majority of their tasks in English. However, as a public authority, the university has Swedish as its main language according to the requirements of the Language Act and the senior lecturer must be able to use Swedish as their working language within four years of beginning the position. The department will provide support with language learning.

Eligibility

The applicant must:

    have successfully completed a doctoral degree or have the equivalent academic qualifications within a subject relevant to the position;
    demonstrate research expertise in the subject for the appointment;
    demonstrate teaching expertise and have the ability to integrate research and a scientific approach into their teaching;
    have experience of teaching at first, second and third cycle level;
    have good knowledge of English;
    have a valid driving licence for passenger car.

Assessment criteria

The assessment criteria for appointment must be the degree of expertise required as qualification for employment.

The assessment of research expertise will be based on:

    completed and ongoing research and its relevance and development potential for the faculty and department;
    the ability to independently initiate and run successful and internationally-recognised research;
    the ability to compete for external research funding;
    experience as a supervisor in doctoral education.

The following will be taken into consideration when assessing teaching expertise:

    planning, implementation, examination and assessment of own teaching;
    supervision and examination at first and second cycle level;
    ability to integrate research and scientific approaches into teaching work;
    training in teaching and learning in higher education, or equivalent knowledge acquired in other ways;
    pedagogic vision and reflection;
    documented pedagogical ability.

The following abilities will also be assessed:

    developing and leading activities and staff within academia;
    communicating and collaborating internally;
    collaborating with external stakeholders and society;
    communicating research and development work.

It is an advantage if the applicant has an established network within the sector in Sweden or internationally.

The appointment will be offered to the applicant who, following a qualitative comprehensive assessment is in the best position to conduct and develop the duties in question, and contribute to the positive development of the organisation.

Additional information

* Swedish “universitetslektor”, a tenured position approximately equivalent to Senior lecturer (UK) or Associate professor (US). The applicant who is offered this employment at SLU will be employed as Senior lecturer.

Application deadline: 2026-11-23

Place of work: Uppsala

Scope: 100 %

Form of Employment: Permanent employment.

Starting date: By agreement.

Application:

For the guidance of your application, there is SLU's appointment procedure for teachers at SLU and General assessment criteria for the appointment of teachers.

Please apply by clicking the apply-button.

jobs.title: KS3 and IGCSE English Teacher (Year 7 – Year 11)
jobs.description:
International School Ikast-Brande (ISIB) is looking for a qualified Cambridge English teacher with experience teaching English to students from Year 7 – Year 11. Preference will be given to candidates who have experience teaching IGCSE First Language English and are native speakers. Interviews will be arranged immediately as the Leadership Team would like to recruit as soon as possible.  

This is a full-time, permanent & pensionable position starting as soon as possible. As an inclusive school, we encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

We value the richness that diverse perspectives and lived experiences bring to our community, and we are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where every individual feels respected and supported.  

 

The School: 

International School Ikast-Brande is located in the heart of Denmark and has approximately 200 students across Early Years, Primary and Secondary sections, with one class per year group. Our students are highly motivated and speak very positively about the school. We are committed to providing high-quality international education to families relocating to Denmark, as well as to local families seeking a rigorous international curriculum for their children.  

Our student body is wonderfully diverse, representing a wide range of nationalities and cultural backgrounds. We encourage our students to balance academic achievement with a well-rounded, healthy lifestyle. From an early age, we instil in them a strong sense of right and wrong, empowering them to make thoughtful and responsible decisions. As a result, we enjoy a positive school climate with very few behavioural issues.  

Our teaching team is as vibrant and international as our student body. You will often hear laughter coming from our staffroom and in the corridors. Our team meets regularly to collaborate on educational and operational matters, fostering a collegial and supportive environment.  

 

Requirements: 

In line with the school’s overarching policies and procedures, the successful candidate will be expected to: 

  • Plan and develop engaging & high-quality lessons, tailored to our learners’ needs; 

  • Maintain a student-focused, positive approach to teaching and learning; 

  • Deliver dynamic, stimulating and culturally engaging lessons;  

  • Promote student wellbeing through an understanding of each child’s individuality;  

  • Assess and report on students’ progress effectively;  

  • Manage student behaviour in a positive and constructive manner;  

  • Participate actively in whole-school activities and events;  

  • Employ a solutions-focused mindset;  

  • Maintain a great sense of humour and contribute to a positive work environment;  

  • Be internationally minded and a collaborative team player. 

 

What We Can Offer: 

  • A competitive salary and excellent pension scheme, in line with collective agreements; 

  • A genuine and sustainable work-life balance; 

  • State-of-the-art, modern teaching and learning facilities; 

  • Small class sizes with engaged, capable and curious students; 

  • A calm and respectful learning environment, with motivated and well-disciplined pupils; 

  • A flexible working culture, built on mutual trust and professional autonomy; 

  • A supportive and visible Senior Leadership Team, deeply committed to staff and community wellbeing; 

  • A leadership approach that values collaboration, open dialogue and teacher voice - ensuring staff feel heard, empowered and appreciated; 

  • A culturally diverse, inclusive and welcoming team of professionals; 

  • Strong, constructive partnerships with engaged and supportive parents; 

  • Ongoing professional learning, development opportunities and team-building events. 

 

What Denmark Can Offer: 

Living and working in Denmark offers a unique opportunity to enjoy one of the world’s highest standards of living. Teachers benefit from: 

  • An excellent work-life balance supported by a strong social welfare system; 

  • A safe, clean and well-organised society with low levels of crime; 

  • High-quality, publicly funded healthcare and childcare services; 

  • A focus on family life, personal wellbeing and professional respect; 

  • Beautiful natural surroundings; 

  • Easy access to travel across Denmark, Europe and further afield; 

  • An international community that welcomes newcomers and supports integration; 

  • A strong commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility. 

 

Salary: 

Salary and pension are determined in accordance with the collective agreement and union contract established between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Teachers’ Central Organisation. 

Please note that both local and international teachers are employed under the same pay scales and working conditions. 

While the school does not offer formal relocation packages, we are committed to supporting new staff and work closely with individuals to find practical and helpful solutions throughout their transition. To further assist international staff with their move, initial relocation support is provided during the first year of employment. 

 

Application: 

If you are a skilled, adaptable and solutions-oriented educator, we warmly invite you to apply by sending your CV and a cover letter outlining your experience to job@isib.dk. Letters of recommendation are also welcomed. All offers of employment are subject to satisfactory police security checks.   

The Senior Leadership Team intends to appoint as soon as a suitable candidate is identified to ensure a smooth transition to our school; therefore, interviews will take place on a rolling basis, and the school reserves the right to make an appointment before the advertised closing date.

jobs.title: Global Sales Developer - Mining
jobs.description:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.



About the job

Mining is an attractive growth market for Alfa Laval, driven by increasing demand for critical and base minerals and a growing focus on more sustainable and efficient mining operations. As part of our global Process Mining Separation team, you will contribute to strengthening Alfa Laval's position in the mining market by turning market knowledge, customer relationships and new opportunities into business.



As Global Sales Developer - Mining, you will work closely with customers, sales companies and colleagues across the global organization to identify where we can grow and how we can win. You will contribute your market insights and ideas to the sales strategy, develop opportunities together with the team, and help turn agreed priorities into commercial results. The role offers broad market exposure and the opportunity to help shape a growing business area without working in isolation-you will influence through knowledge, collaboration and strong relationships.



Key responsibilities include:

    

Identify and develop new sales opportunities for Alfa Laval decanters within the mining market.

    

Build and strengthen relationships with mining customers, sales companies and external partners.

    

Contribute customer and market insights to sales strategy, including target customers, applications and market priorities.

    

Work with the global team to explore and develop opportunities across different regions and technology conversion.

    

Build partnerships that support Alfa Laval's growth and position within the mining industry.

    

Follow market trends, customer needs and industry developments to identify new business opportunities.

    

Contribute to external messaging and market activities that position Alfa Laval's decanter technology as a sustainable solution for mining operations.



Who are you

You are a commercially driven and proactive person who enjoys being close to the market, building relationships and turning ideas into contracts. You are curious and open to learning, while confident enough to challenge ideas, share your perspective and stand behind your recommendations. You influence through credibility, dialogue and persuasion, and you value finding the right solution together with others rather than competing for ownership. You are comfortable working in a global team, take initiative when you see an opportunity, and maintain your drive when building a market requires persistence and patience.



What you know

To succeed in this role, you combine strong commercial understanding with a technical mindset and the ability to understand customer needs and translate them into business opportunities.

    

Several years of experience in a technical-commercial, sales or business development role in mining.

    

Strong commercial and business orientation, with a track record of developing customer relationships and sales opportunities.

    

Engineering degree or equivalent technical education.

    

Technical background, preferably within separation technologies, process equipment or a related field.

    

Knowledge and experience from the mining industry.

    

Ability to understand technical solutions and connect them to customer needs and business value.

    

Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to interact with customers, partners and internal stakeholders at different levels.

    

Fluent English. Spanish is an advantage.



What's in it for you

You will join a global team working in an attractive and evolving mining market, with significant opportunities to grow Alfa Laval's presence and impact. The role gives you broad exposure to customers, markets and sales organizations across the world, while allowing you to work alongside colleagues with deep technical and industry expertise. You will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of a growing business area and play a visible role in bringing more sustainable separation solutions to the mining industry.



For more information, please contact

Luciana Perina Mendes, Global Sales Manager at  or Raquel Herndon, Talent Acquisition Partner at

jobs.title: SSAB - Design Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about engineering, product development, and innovative vehicle design? We are looking for a Design Specialist to join the expert team at SSAB Knowledge Service Center.

SSAB is a globally recognized leader in advanced high-strength steels, helping automotive manufacturers build safer, lighter, and more sustainable vehicles. In this role, you will work at the intersection of materials technology, structural analysis, and forming simulation to support the development of next-generation automotive solutions.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, collaborating with customers, and using advanced simulation tools to turn innovative concepts into robust, manufacturable products.

We are seeking an experienced engineering professional with strong analytical skills, deep technical expertise, and a genuine interest in product development, structural analysis, and sheet metal forming. Location: Borlänge

Becoming part of the SSAB family means joining a journey. A journey that we believe is essential for the sustainability of this planet. Steel has been one of the most important materials for developing our society and it will continue to be so. In the roofs over our heads, in the bridges connecting our cities and in the cars of tomorrow. At SSAB we are proud of our history and leadership in high-strength steel. But we are also aware that the production of steel is one of the largest emitters of greenhouse gases in the world. That has to change. That is why we have developed the world’s ﬁrst fossil free steel production and has committed to becoming largely fossil-free. As part of SSAB you will be instrumental in realizing this goal and push for the green transformation of the whole steel industry.

About the position

As a Design Specialist, you will provide expert guidance on structural performance, forming feasibility, simulation methods, material behavior, and application development. Your expertise will help customers optimize components and structures for performance, manufacturability, and sustainability using SSAB’s portfolio of advanced steel grades.

You will focus on the mobility segment, developing conceptual designs, evaluating structural performance, and predicting manufacturing outcomes, often in close collaboration with vehicle manufacturers.

Your daily work will include structural analyses, forming simulations, material data evaluation, method development, problem-solving, and knowledge sharing.

You will join a highly skilled team of steel experts who combine deep technical expertise with strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.  

Main responsibilities

    Develop design concepts that illustrate the benifits and applications of advanced steel grades
    Collaborate with automotive customers in designing and optimizing components and body structures  
    Perform structural analyses using finite element methods (FEM) to assess structural performance and lightweighting possibilities
    Conduct forming simulations to evaluate manufacturability and process robustness
    Develop and validate simulation methodologies, material models, and engineering workflows
    Provide customers and colleagues with technical expertise in structural performance, forming processes, material behavior, and design optimization
    Develop and deliver technical training, workshops, seminars, and presentations tailored to customers and business needs



About you

    A master’s degree or higher in mechanical engineering, materials engineering, engineering physics, vehicle engineering, or a related field
    At least five years of experience in the automotive, manufacturing, or engineering industry
    Solid knowledge of and experience in structural analysis and/or sheet metal forming simulation.  
    Experience using CAE tools such as LS-DYNA, Abaqus, ANSYS, AutoForm, or PAM-STAMP
    Excellent written and spoken English



To thrive and succeed in this role, you should also:

    Communicate clearly and build strong working relationships
    Enjoy solving complex technical challenges and finding practical solutions
    See the big picture and connect technical details to broader business needs
    Contribute as a collaborative team player  



It is an advantage if you have:

    Experience in automotive product development, body-in-white engineering, crash analysis, durability, or lightweight design
    Knowledge of advanced high-strength steels and their use in automotive structures
    Knowledge of Swedish and a strong ambition to become fluent

Our offer

We offer a range of valued employee benefits, including:

    Profit sharing
    Improved work-life balance through reduced working hours
    Wellness grants

Recruitment process

    Application
    Assessments
    Interview
    Reference check
    Health examination
    Offer and contract signing

A background check may form part of the recruitment process. The health examination includes drug testing.

Questions? Contact us about this position

Email linda.petersson@ssab.com

Trade union information is provided by Akademikerföreningen, Unionen, and Ledarna, who can be reached through our switchboard at +46 243 700 00.

A message from your future manager

“At the Knowledge Service Center, our multi-site team of 25 skilled experts works closely with SSAB’s customers to develop new solutions and technologies and solve unique challenges. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, innovate, and create value.

If you are passionate about product development, structural analysis, and engineering innovation, you will find exciting challenges and great colleagues here. We look forward to welcoming you to our team.”

Linda Petersson

Head of Knowledge Service Center, SSAB Europe
